properties.name: Assessment Condition
properties.definition: The overall condition of a product based on an assessment of the contributions to the overall condition made by the various criteria considered. The meanings given to the values of assessed condition should be agreed and documented by local agreements. For instance, is overall condition measured on a scale of 1 - 10 or by assigning names such as Good, OK, Poor.

properties.name: Specification Section Number

Protective Earth is sometimes also known as CPC or common protective conductor. Note that for an electrical device, a set of line conductor functions may be applied.

properties.name: Ik Code
properties.definition: IK Code according to IEC 62262 (2002) is a numeric classification for the degree of protection provided by enclosures for electrical equipment against external mechanical impacts.

properties.name: Insulation Standard Class
properties.definition: Insulation standard classes provides basic protection information against electric shock. Defines levels of insulation required in terms of constructional requirements (creepage and clearance distances) and electrical requirements (compliance with electric strength tests). Basic insulation is considered to be shorted under single fault conditions. The actual values required depend on the working voltage to which the insulation is subjected, as well as other factors. Also indicates whether the electrical device has a protective earth connection.

properties.name: IP Code
properties.definition: IP Code, the International Protection Marking, IEC 60529), classifies and rates the degree of protection provided against intrusion.

properties.name: Associated Activity

properties.name: Mitigated Risk Consequence

properties.name: Mitigated Risk Likelihood

properties.name: Mitigated Risk Significance

properties.name: Mitigation Planned
properties.definition: The planned (agreed and irrevocable) mitigation of the likelhood and consequences of the hazard.

properties.name: Mitigation Proposed
properties.definition: Any proposed, but not yet agreed and irrevocable, mitigation of the likelhood and consequences of the hazard.

properties.name: Nature of Risk
properties.definition: A description of the generic nature of the context or hazard that might be encountered.

properties.name: Risk Assessment Methodology
properties.definition: An indication or link to the chosen risk assessment methodology, for example PAS1192-6 or a chosen ISO13100 annex.

properties.name: Risk Name
properties.definition: A locally unique identifier for the risk entry that can be used to track the development and mitigation of the risk throughout the project life cycle

properties.name: Risk Type
properties.definition: Identifies the predefined types of risk from which the type required may be set.

properties.name: Unmitigated Risk Consequence
properties.definition: Identifies the consequence of the hazard prior to any specific mitigation.

properties.name: Unmitigated Risk Likelihood
properties.definition: Identifies the likelihood of the hazard prior to any specific mitigation.

properties.name: Unmitigated Risk Significance
properties.definition: Identifies the significance of the risk given the likelihood and consequence prior to any specific mitigation.

properties.name: Mean Time Between Failure
properties.definition: The average time duration between instances of failure of a product.

properties.name: Service Life Duration
properties.definition: The length or duration of a service life.The lower bound indicates pessimistic service life, the upper bound indicates optimistic service life, and the setpoint indicates the typical service life.

properties.name: Sound Curve
properties.definition: [[Sound]] curve.

properties.name: Elevational Flat Ness
properties.definition: Indicative (95%-100%) range flatness associated to the elevational surface in ZX, if different to the overall flatness.

properties.name: Horizontal Flat Ness
properties.definition: Indicative (95%-100%) range flatness associated to the horizontal surface in XY, if different to the overall flatness.

properties.name: Horizontal Orthogonality
properties.definition: Indicative (95%-100%) range orthogonality associated to the horizontal shape and orientation in X, if different to the overall orthogonality.

properties.name: Horizontal Straightness
properties.definition: Indicative (95%-100%) range straightness associated to the horizontal shape in X, if different to the overall straightness.

properties.name: Horizontal Tolerance
properties.definition: Indicative (95%-100%) range tolerance associated to the horizontal shape and position in X, if different to the overall tolerance.

properties.name: Orthogonal Orthogonality
properties.definition: Indicative (95%-100%) range orthogonality associated to the horizontal shape and orientation in Y, if different to the overall orthogonality.

properties.name: Orthogonal Straightness
properties.definition: Indicative (95%-100%) range straightness associated to the horizontal shape in Y, if different to the overall straightness.

properties.name: Orthogonal Tolerance
properties.definition: Indicative (95%-100%) range tolerance associated to the horizontal shape and position in Y, if different to the overall tolerance.

properties.name: Overall Orthogonality
properties.definition: Indicative (95%-100%) range orthogonality associated to the intended shape and orientation in XYZ.

properties.name: Overall Straightness
properties.definition: Indicative (95%-100%) range straightness associated to the intended shape.

properties.name: Overall Tolerance
properties.definition: Indicative (95%-100%) range tolerance associated to the intended shape and position in XYZ.

properties.name: Planar Flat Ness
properties.definition: Indicative (95%-100%) range flatness associated to the intended shape and position in XYZ.

properties.name: Side Flat Ness
properties.definition: Indicative (95%-100%) range flatness associated to the side surface in YZ, if different to the overall flatness.

properties.name: Tolerance Basis
properties.definition: Indication of the basis of the tolerance requirement

properties.name: Tolerance Description
properties.definition: General description of the tolerance associated to the element or feature, its source and implications.

properties.name: Vertical Orthogonality

properties.name: Vertical Straightness

properties.name: Vertical Tolerance
properties.definition: Indicative (95%-100%) range tolerance associated to the vertical shape and position in Z, if different to the overall tolerance.

properties.name: Horizontal Uncertainty
properties.definition: Indicative (95%-100%) range diameter associated to the vertical shape and position in X, if different to the linear uncertainty.

properties.name: Linear Uncertainty
properties.definition: Indicative (95%-100%) range diameter associated to the overall shape and position in XYZ.

properties.name: Orthogonal Uncertainty
properties.definition: Indicative (95%-100%) range diameter associated to the horizontal shape and position in Y, if different to the horizontal uncertainty.

properties.name: Uncertainty Basis
properties.definition: Indication of the basis of the uncertainty

properties.name: Uncertainty Description
properties.definition: General description of the uncertainty associated to the element or feature, its source and implications.

properties.name: Vertical Uncertainty
properties.definition: Indicative (95%-100%) range diameter associated to the vertical shape and position in Z, if different to the linear uncertainty.

properties.name: Exclusions
properties.definition: Items, conditions or actions that may be excluded from the warranty or that may cause the warranty to become void.

properties.name: Is Extended Warranty
properties.definition: Indication of whether this is an extended warranty whose duration is greater than that normally assigned to an artefact (=TRUE) or not (= FALSE).

properties.name: Point of Contact
properties.definition: The organization that should be contacted for action under the terms of the warranty. Note that the role of the organization (manufacturer, supplier, installer etc.) is determined by the IfcActorRole attribute of IfcOrganization.

properties.name: Warranty Content
properties.definition: The content of the warranty.

properties.name: Warranty Identifier
properties.definition: The identifier assigned to a warranty.

properties.name: Warranty Period
properties.definition: The time duration during which a manufacturer or supplier guarantees or warrants the performance of an artefact.

properties.name: Warranty Start Date
properties.definition: The date on which the warranty commences.

properties.name: Gross Surface Area
properties.definition: Total gross area of the object, normally generated as perimeter * length + 2 * cross section area. It is the sum of [[OuterSurfaceArea]] + (2 x [[CrossSectionArea]]) and shall only be given, if the [[OuterSurfaceArea]] and [[CrossSectionArea]] cannot be established separately.

properties.name: Gross Volume
properties.definition: Total gross volume of the object. Openings, recesses, enclosed objects and projections are not taken into account.

properties.name: Net Surface Area
properties.definition: Net surface area of the object, normally generated as perimeter * length + 2 * cross section area taking into account possible processing features (cut-out's, etc.) or openings and recesses.

properties.name: Net Volume
properties.definition: Total net volume of the object, taking into account possible processing features (cut-out's, etc.) or openings and recesses.

properties.name: Surface Genus After Features
properties.definition: The Surface Genus of the evaluated representation items after applying product-level geometric features such as openings and projections.Surface Genus is a topological measure that represents the number of 'holes' or 'handles' on a surface. For example, a sphere has genus 0, and a torus has genus 1.

properties.name: Surface Genus Before Features
properties.definition: The Surface Genus of the evaluated representation items before applying product-level geometric features such as openings and projections.Surface Genus is a topological measure that represents the number of 'holes' or 'handles' on a surface. For example, a sphere has genus 0, and a torus has genus 1.

properties.name: Gross Cross Section Area
properties.definition: [[Area]] of the cross section.

properties.name: Gross Weight
properties.definition: Total Gross [[Weight]] of the object without any add-on parts and not taking into account possible processing features (cut-out's, etc.) or openings and recesses.

properties.name: Length
properties.definition: The length of the object.

properties.name: Net Cross Section Area
properties.definition: [[Area]] of the cross section of the object.

properties.name: Outer Surface Area
properties.definition: Total area of the surfaces of the object (not taking into account the end cap areas), normally generated as perimeter * length in case of extrusions.

entities.name: Duct Segment
entities.definition: A duct segment is used to typically join two sections of duct network.

predefinedTypes.name: Flexible Segment
predefinedTypes.definition: A flexible segment is a continuous non-linear segment of duct that can be deformed and change the direction of flow.

predefinedTypes.name: Rigid Segment
predefinedTypes.definition: A rigid segment is a continuous linear segment of duct that cannot be deformed.

properties.name: Description
properties.definition: Optional description, provided for exchanging informative comments.

properties.name: Element Type
properties.definition: The type denotes a particular type that indicates the object further. The use has to be established at the level of instantiable subtypes. In particular it holds the user defined type, if the enumeration of the attribute 'PredefinedType' is set to [[USERDEFINED]].

properties.name: Global ID
properties.definition: Assignment of a globally unique identifier within the entire software world.

properties.name: Name
properties.definition: Optional name for use by the participating software systems or users. For some subtypes of [[IfcRoot]] the insertion of the [[Name]] attribute may be required. This would be enforced by a where rule.

properties.name: Object Type
properties.definition: The type denotes a particular type that indicates the object further. The use has to be established at the level of instantiable subtypes. In particular it holds the user defined type, if the enumeration of the attribute PredefinedType is set to [[USERDEFINED]] or when the concrete entity instantiated does not have a PredefinedType attribute. The latter is the case in some exceptional leaf classes and when instantiating [[IfcBuiltElement]] directly.

properties.name: Tag
properties.definition: The tag (or label) identifier at the particular instance of a product, e.g. the serial number, or the position number. It is the identifier at the occurrence level.

properties.name: Assessment Condition
properties.definition: The overall condition of a product based on an assessment of the contributions to the overall condition made by the various criteria considered. The meanings given to the values of assessed condition should be agreed and documented by local agreements. For instance, is overall condition measured on a scale of 1 - 10 or by assigning names such as Good, OK, Poor.

properties.name: Assessment Date
properties.definition: Date on which the overall condition is assessed

properties.name: Assessment Description
properties.definition: Qualitative description of the condition.

properties.name: Assessment Frequency
properties.definition: Indicates how often the equipment should be assessed, to have a clear estimation on its working state, based on which the maintenance staff can decide whether it requires maintenance or requires to be updated or replaced.

properties.name: Assessment Method
properties.definition: External reference to assessment method or application used to perform the assessment.

properties.name: Assessment Type
properties.definition: [[Category]] of latest condition assessment report of the asset.

properties.name: Last Assessment Report
properties.definition: Reference to latest condition (state of health) report.

properties.name: Next Assessment Date
properties.definition: Date of next condition inspection

properties.name: Procurement Method
properties.definition: The method by which an IfcProductType/[[IfcProduct]] is acquired and installed.CFCI (meaning Contractor Furnished Contractor Installed), OFCI (meaning Owner Furnished Contractor Installed), or OFOI (meaning Owner Furnished Owner Installed).

properties.name: Specification Section Number
properties.definition: A reference number to an external contract technical specification section describing either (a) minimum performance requirements of a given IfcProductType/[[IfcProduct]] or (b) a preselection for a specific IfcProductType/[[IfcProduct]] made for this project.

properties.name: Submittal Identifer
properties.definition: The reference number to an external construction administration submittal used by the construction contractor and/or subcontractor to verify that the referenced IfcProductType/[[IfcProduct]] selection conforms with the requirements found in the referenced [[SpecificationSectionNumber]].

properties.name: Asset Identifier
properties.definition: A unique identification assigned to an asset that enables its differentiation from other assets.

properties.name: Installation Date
properties.definition: Date on which the element is installed.

properties.name: Model Number
properties.definition: The model number and/or unit designator assigned by the manufacturer of the manufactured item.

properties.name: Tag Number
properties.definition: Tag number.

properties.name: Colour
properties.definition: [[Colour]] of this object.

properties.name: Has Liner
properties.definition: TRUE if the fitting has interior duct insulating lining, FALSE if it does not.

properties.name: Interior Roughness Coefficient
properties.definition: The interior roughness of the material of the object.

properties.name: Atmospheric Pressure
properties.definition: Ambient atmospheric pressure.

properties.name: Fluid Flow Leakage
properties.definition: Volumetric leakage flow rate.

properties.name: Leakage Curve History
properties.definition: [[Leakage]] per unit length curve versus working pressure. If a scalar is expressed then it represents [[LeakageClass]] which is flowrate per unit area at a specified pressure rating (e.g., ASHRAE Fundamentals 2001 34.16.).

properties.name: Loss Coefficient
properties.definition: Dimensionless loss coefficient used for calculating fluid resistance representing the ratio of total pressure loss to velocity pressure at a referenced cross-section.

properties.name: Cross Section Shape
properties.definition: Cross sectional shape. Note that this shape is uniform throughout the length of the segment. For nonuniform shapes, a transition fitting should be used instead.

properties.name: Longitudinal Seam
properties.definition: The type of seam to be used along the longitudinal axis of the duct segment.

properties.name: Nominal Diameter or Width
properties.definition: The nominal diameter or width of the duct segment.

properties.name: Nominal Height
properties.definition: The nominal height of the object. The size information is provided in addition to the shape representation and the geometric parameters used within. In cases of inconsistency between the geometric parameters and the size properties, provided in the attached property set, the geometric parameters take precedence.

properties.name: Pressure Range
properties.definition: Allowable maximum and minimum working pressure (relative to ambient pressure).

properties.name: Reinforcement
properties.definition: The type of reinforcement, if any, used for the duct segment.

properties.name: Reinforcement Spacing
properties.definition: The spacing between reinforcing elements.

properties.name: Status
properties.definition: [[Status]] of the element, predominately used in renovation or retrofitting projects. The status can be assigned to as 'New' - element designed as new addition, 'Existing' - element exists and remains, 'Demolish' - element existed but is to be demolished, 'Temporary' - element will exists only temporary (like a temporary support structure).

allowedValues.description: 'Demolish' - element existed but is to be demolished
The status can be assigned to as 'New' - element designed as new addition
'Temporary' - element will exists only temporary (like a temporary support structure)

properties.name: Temperature Range
properties.definition: Allowable maximum and minimum temperature.

properties.name: Working Pressure
properties.definition: Working pressure.

properties.name: Conductor Function
properties.definition: Indicates function of the conductors to which the load is connected. Where L1, L2 and L3 represent the phase lines according to IEC 60446 notation (sometimes phase lines may be referenced by color Red, Blue, Yellow or by number 1, 2, 3 etc). Protective Earth is sometimes also known as CPC or common protective conductor. Note that for an electrical device, a set of line conductor functions may be applied.

properties.name: Earthing Style
properties.definition: Indicates the earthing style of the electric device.

properties.name: Has Protective Earth
properties.definition: Indicates whether the object has a protective earth connection (=TRUE) or not (= FALSE).

properties.name: Heat Dissipation
properties.definition: Indicates the heat dissipation of the electric device measured in power.

properties.name: Ik Code
properties.definition: IK Code according to IEC 62262 (2002) is a numeric classification for the degree of protection provided by enclosures for electrical equipment against external mechanical impacts.

properties.name: Insulation Standard Class
properties.definition: Insulation standard classes provides basic protection information against electric shock. Defines levels of insulation required in terms of constructional requirements (creepage and clearance distances) and electrical requirements (compliance with electric strength tests). Basic insulation is considered to be shorted under single fault conditions. The actual values required depend on the working voltage to which the insulation is subjected, as well as other factors. Also indicates whether the electrical device has a protective earth connection.

properties.name: IP Code
properties.definition: IP Code, the International Protection Marking, IEC 60529), classifies and rates the degree of protection provided against intrusion.

properties.name: Nominal Frequency Range
properties.definition: The upper and lower limits of frequency for which the operation of the device is certified.

properties.name: Nominal Power Consumption

properties.name: Number of Poles

properties.name: Number of Power Supply Ports

entities.definition: The resulting void from modification of existing terrain or road structure by excavation or by other means of removing material.

predefinedTypes.name: Base Excavation
predefinedTypes.definition: Excavation for basements of buildings, abutments of bridges or similar structures either partially or completely below ground level.

predefinedTypes.name: Cut
predefinedTypes.definition: Excavation where soil or rock below topsoil is cut to the depth required for the construction of facilities such as roads and railways. The removed material can be used as fill ([[IfcEarthworksElement]]) for embankments or to form a level surface on which to build.

predefinedTypes.name: Dredging
predefinedTypes.definition: Underwater excavation to recover material or to create a greater depth of water.

predefinedTypes.name: Excavation
predefinedTypes.definition: General type of excavation when more accurate type is not specified.

predefinedTypes.name: Over Excavation
predefinedTypes.definition: Excavation that goes beyond the depth required for construction, in order to replace unsuitable material.

predefinedTypes.name: Pavement Milling
predefinedTypes.definition: Removal of expired material from top of pavement to be replaced by new material.

predefinedTypes.name: Step Excavation
predefinedTypes.definition: Removal of the soft part of the existing road slope, where it is dug into steps, when widening a road.

predefinedTypes.name: Top Soil Removal
predefinedTypes.definition: Excavation where the topmost layer of soil containing organic material is cut or stripped. The removed topsoil can be used as fill (EarthworksElement) e.g. where planting is planned.

predefinedTypes.name: Trench
predefinedTypes.definition: Excavation whose length greatly exceeds the depth and width. Trench is typically excavated for strip foundations or for buried services such as drainage or cabling.

properties.name: Associated Activity
properties.definition: An indication or link to any associated activity or process that may trigger the hazard. If used directly on an annotation or semantic object. for an alternative see group use encoding template

properties.name: Associated Location
properties.definition: An indication or link to any associated location or space that may trigger the hazard. If used directly on an annotation or semantic object. for an alternative see group use encoding template

properties.name: Associated Product
properties.definition: An indication or link to any associated product or material that may trigger the hazard. If used directly on an annotation or semantic object. for an alternative see group use encoding template

properties.name: Mitigated Risk Consequence
properties.definition: Identifies the consequence of the hazard given the planned mitigation.

properties.name: Mitigated Risk Likelihood
properties.definition: Identifies the likelihood of the hazard given the planned mitigation.

properties.name: Mitigated Risk Significance
properties.definition: Identifies the significance of the risk given the mitigation of likelihood and consequence.

properties.name: Mitigation Planned
properties.definition: The planned (agreed and irrevocable) mitigation of the likelhood and consequences of the hazard.

properties.name: Mitigation Proposed
properties.definition: Any proposed, but not yet agreed and irrevocable, mitigation of the likelhood and consequences of the hazard.

properties.name: Nature of Risk
properties.definition: A description of the generic nature of the context or hazard that might be encountered.

properties.name: Risk Assessment Methodology
properties.definition: An indication or link to the chosen risk assessment methodology, for example PAS1192-6 or a chosen ISO13100 annex.

properties.name: Risk Name
properties.definition: A locally unique identifier for the risk entry that can be used to track the development and mitigation of the risk throughout the project life cycle

properties.name: Risk Type
properties.definition: Identifies the predefined types of risk from which the type required may be set.

properties.name: Unmitigated Risk Consequence
properties.definition: Identifies the consequence of the hazard prior to any specific mitigation.

properties.name: Unmitigated Risk Likelihood
properties.definition: Identifies the likelihood of the hazard prior to any specific mitigation.

properties.name: Unmitigated Risk Significance
properties.definition: Identifies the significance of the risk given the likelihood and consequence prior to any specific mitigation.

properties.name: Mean Time Between Failure
properties.definition: The average time duration between instances of failure of a product.

properties.name: Service Life Duration
properties.definition: The length or duration of a service life.The lower bound indicates pessimistic service life, the upper bound indicates optimistic service life, and the setpoint indicates the typical service life.

properties.name: Elevational Flat Ness
properties.definition: Indicative (95%-100%) range flatness associated to the elevational surface in ZX, if different to the overall flatness.

properties.name: Horizontal Flat Ness
properties.definition: Indicative (95%-100%) range flatness associated to the horizontal surface in XY, if different to the overall flatness.

properties.name: Horizontal Orthogonality
properties.definition: Indicative (95%-100%) range orthogonality associated to the horizontal shape and orientation in X, if different to the overall orthogonality.

properties.name: Horizontal Straightness
properties.definition: Indicative (95%-100%) range straightness associated to the horizontal shape in X, if different to the overall straightness.

properties.name: Horizontal Tolerance
properties.definition: Indicative (95%-100%) range tolerance associated to the horizontal shape and position in X, if different to the overall tolerance.

properties.name: Orthogonal Orthogonality
properties.definition: Indicative (95%-100%) range orthogonality associated to the horizontal shape and orientation in Y, if different to the overall orthogonality.

properties.name: Orthogonal Straightness
properties.definition: Indicative (95%-100%) range straightness associated to the horizontal shape in Y, if different to the overall straightness.

properties.name: Orthogonal Tolerance
properties.definition: Indicative (95%-100%) range tolerance associated to the horizontal shape and position in Y, if different to the overall tolerance.

properties.name: Overall Orthogonality
properties.definition: Indicative (95%-100%) range orthogonality associated to the intended shape and orientation in XYZ.

properties.name: Overall Straightness
properties.definition: Indicative (95%-100%) range straightness associated to the intended shape.

properties.name: Overall Tolerance
properties.definition: Indicative (95%-100%) range tolerance associated to the intended shape and position in XYZ.

properties.name: Planar Flat Ness
properties.definition: Indicative (95%-100%) range flatness associated to the intended shape and position in XYZ.

properties.name: Side Flat Ness
properties.definition: Indicative (95%-100%) range flatness associated to the side surface in YZ, if different to the overall flatness.

properties.name: Tolerance Basis
properties.definition: Indication of the basis of the tolerance requirement

properties.name: Tolerance Description
properties.definition: General description of the tolerance associated to the element or feature, its source and implications.

properties.name: Vertical Orthogonality
properties.definition: Indicative (95%-100%) range orthogonality associated to the vertical shape and orientation in Z, if different to the overall orthogonality.

properties.name: Vertical Straightness
properties.definition: Indicative (95%-100%) range straightness associated to the vertical shape in Z, if different to the overall straightness.

properties.name: Vertical Tolerance
properties.definition: Indicative (95%-100%) range tolerance associated to the vertical shape and position in Z, if different to the overall tolerance.

properties.name: Horizontal Uncertainty
properties.definition: Indicative (95%-100%) range diameter associated to the vertical shape and position in X, if different to the linear uncertainty.

properties.name: Linear Uncertainty
properties.definition: Indicative (95%-100%) range diameter associated to the overall shape and position in XYZ.

properties.name: Orthogonal Uncertainty
properties.definition: Indicative (95%-100%) range diameter associated to the horizontal shape and position in Y, if different to the horizontal uncertainty.

properties.name: Uncertainty Basis
properties.definition: Indication of the basis of the uncertainty

properties.name: Uncertainty Description
properties.definition: General description of the uncertainty associated to the element or feature, its source and implications.

properties.name: Vertical Uncertainty
properties.definition: Indicative (95%-100%) range diameter associated to the vertical shape and position in Z, if different to the linear uncertainty.

properties.name: Exclusions
properties.definition: Items, conditions or actions that may be excluded from the warranty or that may cause the warranty to become void.

properties.name: Is Extended Warranty
properties.definition: Indication of whether this is an extended warranty whose duration is greater than that normally assigned to an artefact (=TRUE) or not (= FALSE).

properties.name: Point of Contact
properties.definition: The organization that should be contacted for action under the terms of the warranty. Note that the role of the organization (manufacturer, supplier, installer etc.) is determined by the IfcActorRole attribute of IfcOrganization.

properties.name: Warranty Content
properties.definition: The content of the warranty.

properties.name: Warranty Identifier
properties.definition: The identifier assigned to a warranty.

properties.name: Warranty Period
properties.definition: The time duration during which a manufacturer or supplier guarantees or warrants the performance of an artefact.

properties.name: Warranty Start Date
properties.definition: The date on which the warranty commences.

properties.name: Gross Surface Area
properties.definition: Total gross area of the object, normally generated as perimeter * length + 2 * cross section area. It is the sum of [[OuterSurfaceArea]] + (2 x [[CrossSectionArea]]) and shall only be given, if the [[OuterSurfaceArea]] and [[CrossSectionArea]] cannot be established separately.

properties.name: Gross Volume
properties.definition: Total gross volume of the object. Openings, recesses, enclosed objects and projections are not taken into account.

properties.name: Net Surface Area
properties.definition: Net surface area of the object, normally generated as perimeter * length + 2 * cross section area taking into account possible processing features (cut-out's, etc.) or openings and recesses.

properties.name: Net Volume
properties.definition: Total net volume of the object, taking into account possible processing features (cut-out's, etc.) or openings and recesses.

properties.name: Surface Genus After Features
properties.definition: The Surface Genus of the evaluated representation items after applying product-level geometric features such as openings and projections.Surface Genus is a topological measure that represents the number of 'holes' or 'handles' on a surface. For example, a sphere has genus 0, and a torus has genus 1.

properties.name: Surface Genus Before Features
properties.definition: The Surface Genus of the evaluated representation items before applying product-level geometric features such as openings and projections.Surface Genus is a topological measure that represents the number of 'holes' or 'handles' on a surface. For example, a sphere has genus 0, and a torus has genus 1.

properties.name: Compacted Volume
properties.definition: [[Volume]] of the earthworks when finished and compacted in place.

properties.name: Depth
properties.definition: The depth of the object.

properties.name: Length
properties.definition: The length of the object.

properties.name: Loose Volume
properties.definition: [[Volume]] of the earthworks when in a loose piled state

properties.name: Width
properties.definition: The width of the object. Only given, if the object has constant thickness (prismatic).

entities.name: Electric Appliance
entities.definition: An electric appliance is a device intended for consumer usage that is powered by electricity.

predefinedTypes.name: Dishwasher
predefinedTypes.definition: An appliance that has the primary function of washing dishes.

predefinedTypes.name: Electric Cooker
predefinedTypes.definition: An electrical appliance that has the primary function of cooking food (including oven, hob, grill).

predefinedTypes.name: Freestanding Electric Heater
predefinedTypes.definition: An electrical appliance that is used occasionally to provide heat. A freestanding electric heater is a 'plugged' appliance whose load may be removed from an electric circuit.

predefinedTypes.name: Freestanding Fan
predefinedTypes.definition: An electrical appliance that is used occasionally to provide ventilation. A freestanding fan is a 'plugged' appliance whose load may be removed from an electric circuit.

predefinedTypes.name: Freestanding Water Cooler
predefinedTypes.definition: A small, local electrical appliance for cooling water. A freestanding water cooler is a 'plugged' appliance whose load may be removed from an electric circuit.

predefinedTypes.name: Freestanding Water Heater
predefinedTypes.definition: A small, local electrical appliance for heating water. A freestanding water heater is a 'plugged' appliance whose load may be removed from an electric circuit.

predefinedTypes.name: Freezer
predefinedTypes.definition: An electrical appliance that has the primary function of storing food at temperatures below the freezing point of water.

predefinedTypes.name: Fridge Freezer
predefinedTypes.definition: An electrical appliance that combines the functions of a freezer and a refrigerator through the provision of separate compartments.

predefinedTypes.name: Hand Dryer
predefinedTypes.definition: An electrical appliance that has the primary function of drying hands.

predefinedTypes.name: Kitchen Machine
predefinedTypes.definition: A specialized appliance used in commercial kitchens such as a mixer.

predefinedTypes.name: Microwave
predefinedTypes.definition: An electrical appliance that has the primary function of cooking food using microwaves.

predefinedTypes.name: Photocopier
predefinedTypes.definition: A machine that has the primary function of reproduction of printed matter.

predefinedTypes.name: Refrigerator
predefinedTypes.definition: An electrical appliance that has the primary function of storing food at low temperature but above the freezing point of water.

predefinedTypes.name: Tumble Dryer
predefinedTypes.definition: An electrical appliance that has the primary function of drying clothes.

predefinedTypes.name: Vending Machine
predefinedTypes.definition: An appliance that stores and vends goods including food, drink, tickets, and goods of various types.

predefinedTypes.name: Washing Machine
predefinedTypes.definition: An appliance that has the primary function of washing clothes.

properties.name: Description
properties.definition: Optional description, provided for exchanging informative comments.

properties.name: Element Type
properties.definition: The type denotes a particular type that indicates the object further. The use has to be established at the level of instantiable subtypes. In particular it holds the user defined type, if the enumeration of the attribute 'PredefinedType' is set to [[USERDEFINED]].

properties.name: Global ID
properties.definition: Assignment of a globally unique identifier within the entire software world.

properties.name: Name
properties.definition: Optional name for use by the participating software systems or users. For some subtypes of [[IfcRoot]] the insertion of the [[Name]] attribute may be required. This would be enforced by a where rule.

properties.name: Object Type
properties.definition: The type denotes a particular type that indicates the object further. The use has to be established at the level of instantiable subtypes. In particular it holds the user defined type, if the enumeration of the attribute PredefinedType is set to [[USERDEFINED]] or when the concrete entity instantiated does not have a PredefinedType attribute. The latter is the case in some exceptional leaf classes and when instantiating [[IfcBuiltElement]] directly.

properties.name: Tag
properties.definition: The tag (or label) identifier at the particular instance of a product, e.g. the serial number, or the position number. It is the identifier at the occurrence level.

properties.name: Assessment Condition
properties.definition: The overall condition of a product based on an assessment of the contributions to the overall condition made by the various criteria considered. The meanings given to the values of assessed condition should be agreed and documented by local agreements. For instance, is overall condition measured on a scale of 1 - 10 or by assigning names such as Good, OK, Poor.

properties.name: Assessment Date
properties.definition: Date on which the overall condition is assessed

properties.name: Assessment Description
properties.definition: Qualitative description of the condition.

properties.name: Assessment Frequency
properties.definition: Indicates how often the equipment should be assessed, to have a clear estimation on its working state, based on which the maintenance staff can decide whether it requires maintenance or requires to be updated or replaced.

properties.name: Assessment Method
properties.definition: External reference to assessment method or application used to perform the assessment.

properties.name: Assessment Type
properties.definition: [[Category]] of latest condition assessment report of the asset.

properties.name: Last Assessment Report
properties.definition: Reference to latest condition (state of health) report.

properties.name: Next Assessment Date
properties.definition: Date of next condition inspection

properties.name: Procurement Method
properties.definition: The method by which an IfcProductType/[[IfcProduct]] is acquired and installed.CFCI (meaning Contractor Furnished Contractor Installed), OFCI (meaning Owner Furnished Contractor Installed), or OFOI (meaning Owner Furnished Owner Installed).

properties.name: Specification Section Number
properties.definition: A reference number to an external contract technical specification section describing either (a) minimum performance requirements of a given IfcProductType/[[IfcProduct]] or (b) a preselection for a specific IfcProductType/[[IfcProduct]] made for this project.

properties.name: Submittal Identifer
properties.definition: The reference number to an external construction administration submittal used by the construction contractor and/or subcontractor to verify that the referenced IfcProductType/[[IfcProduct]] selection conforms with the requirements found in the referenced [[SpecificationSectionNumber]].

properties.name: Asset Identifier
properties.definition: A unique identification assigned to an asset that enables its differentiation from other assets.

properties.name: Installation Date
properties.definition: Date on which the element is installed.

properties.name: Model Number
properties.definition: The model number and/or unit designator assigned by the manufacturer of the manufactured item.

properties.name: Tag Number
properties.definition: Tag number.

properties.name: Conductor Function
properties.definition: Indicates function of the conductors to which the load is connected. Where L1, L2 and L3 represent the phase lines according to IEC 60446 notation (sometimes phase lines may be referenced by color Red, Blue, Yellow or by number 1, 2, 3 etc). Protective Earth is sometimes also known as CPC or common protective conductor. Note that for an electrical device, a set of line conductor functions may be applied.

properties.name: Earthing Style
properties.definition: Indicates the earthing style of the electric device.

properties.name: Has Protective Earth
properties.definition: Indicates whether the object has a protective earth connection (=TRUE) or not (= FALSE).

properties.name: Heat Dissipation
properties.definition: Indicates the heat dissipation of the electric device measured in power.

properties.name: Ik Code
properties.definition: IK Code according to IEC 62262 (2002) is a numeric classification for the degree of protection provided by enclosures for electrical equipment against external mechanical impacts.

properties.name: Insulation Standard Class
properties.definition: Insulation standard classes provides basic protection information against electric shock. Defines levels of insulation required in terms of constructional requirements (creepage and clearance distances) and electrical requirements (compliance with electric strength tests). Basic insulation is considered to be shorted under single fault conditions. The actual values required depend on the working voltage to which the insulation is subjected, as well as other factors. Also indicates whether the electrical device has a protective earth connection.

properties.name: IP Code
properties.definition: IP Code, the International Protection Marking, IEC 60529), classifies and rates the degree of protection provided against intrusion.

properties.name: Nominal Frequency Range
properties.definition: The upper and lower limits of frequency for which the operation of the device is certified.

properties.name: Nominal Power Consumption
properties.definition: Nominal total power consumption.

properties.name: Number of Poles
properties.definition: Number of poles that the object would affect.

properties.name: Number of Power Supply Ports
properties.definition: Indicates the number of power supply ports of the electric device.

properties.name: Power
properties.definition: The actual power and operable range.

properties.name: Power Factor
properties.definition: [[Power]] factor; usually as ratio.

properties.name: Rated Current
properties.definition: The current that a device is designed to handle.

properties.name: Rated Voltage
properties.definition: The range of allowed voltage that a device is certified to handle. The upper bound of this value is the maximum.

properties.name: Electro Magnetic Standards Compliance
properties.definition: Information about compliance with regard to electro magnetic related standards.

properties.name: Explosive Atmosphere Standards Compliance
properties.definition: Information about compliance with regard to explosive atmosphere related standards.

properties.name: Fire P Roofing Standards Compliance
properties.definition: Information about compliance with regard to fire proofing related standards.

properties.name: Lightning Protection Standards Compliance
properties.definition: Information about compliance with regard to lightning protection related standards.

properties.name: Power State
properties.definition: Indicates the power state of the device where True is on and False is off.

properties.name: Status
properties.definition: [[Status]] of the element, predominately used in renovation or retrofitting projects. The status can be assigned to as 'New' - element designed as new addition, 'Existing' - element exists and remains, 'Demolish' - element existed but is to be demolished, 'Temporary' - element will exists only temporary (like a temporary support structure).

allowedValues.description: 'Demolish' - element existed but is to be demolished

properties.definition: The organization that manufactured and/or assembled the item.

properties.name: Model Label
properties.definition: The descriptive model name of the product model (or product line) as assigned by the manufacturer of the manufactured item.

properties.name: Model Reference
properties.definition: The model number or designator of the product model (or product line) as assigned by the manufacturer of the manufactured item.

properties.name: Operational Document
properties.definition: [[Manufacturer]]'s operational document

properties.name: Performance Certificate
properties.definition: [[Manufacturer]]'s performance certificate

properties.name: Production Year
properties.definition: The year of production of the manufactured item.

properties.name: Safety Document
properties.definition: [[Manufacturer]]'s safety document

properties.name: Mean Time to Repair
properties.definition: Mean time to repair.

properties.name: Repair Content
properties.definition: Content of repair, reason and nature can be given, e.g. display faults, communication failure, display exchange.

properties.name: Repair Date
properties.definition: Date on which the last repair is done on the asset.

properties.name: Associated Activity
properties.definition: An indication or link to any associated activity or process that may trigger the hazard. If used directly on an annotation or semantic object. for an alternative see group use encoding template

properties.name: Associated Location
properties.definition: An indication or link to any associated location or space that may trigger the hazard. If used directly on an annotation or semantic object. for an alternative see group use encoding template

properties.name: Associated Product
properties.definition: An indication or link to any associated product or material that may trigger the hazard. If used directly on an annotation or semantic object. for an alternative see group use encoding template

properties.name: Mitigated Risk Consequence
properties.definition: Identifies the consequence of the hazard given the planned mitigation.

properties.name: Mitigated Risk Likelihood
properties.definition: Identifies the likelihood of the hazard given the planned mitigation.

properties.name: Mitigated Risk Significance
properties.definition: Identifies the significance of the risk given the mitigation of likelihood and consequence.

properties.name: Mitigation Planned
properties.definition: The planned (agreed and irrevocable) mitigation of the likelhood and consequences of the hazard.

properties.name: Mitigation Proposed
properties.definition: Any proposed, but not yet agreed and irrevocable, mitigation of the likelhood and consequences of the hazard.

properties.name: Nature of Risk
properties.definition: A description of the generic nature of the context or hazard that might be encountered.

properties.name: Risk Assessment Methodology
properties.definition: An indication or link to the chosen risk assessment methodology, for example PAS1192-6 or a chosen ISO13100 annex.

properties.name: Risk Name
properties.definition: A locally unique identifier for the risk entry that can be used to track the development and mitigation of the risk throughout the project life cycle

properties.name: Risk Type
properties.definition: Identifies the predefined types of risk from which the type required may be set.

properties.name: Unmitigated Risk Consequence
properties.definition: Identifies the consequence of the hazard prior to any specific mitigation.

properties.name: Unmitigated Risk Likelihood
properties.definition: Identifies the likelihood of the hazard prior to any specific mitigation.

properties.name: Unmitigated Risk Significance
properties.definition: Identifies the significance of the risk given the likelihood and consequence prior to any specific mitigation.

properties.name: Mean Time Between Failure
properties.definition: The average time duration between instances of failure of a product.

properties.name: Service Life Duration
properties.definition: The length or duration of a service life.The lower bound indicates pessimistic service life, the upper bound indicates optimistic service life, and the setpoint indicates the typical service life.

properties.name: Sound Curve
properties.definition: [[Sound]] curve.

properties.name: Elevational Flat Ness
properties.definition: Indicative (95%-100%) range flatness associated to the elevational surface in ZX, if different to the overall flatness.

properties.name: Horizontal Flat Ness
properties.definition: Indicative (95%-100%) range flatness associated to the horizontal surface in XY, if different to the overall flatness.

properties.name: Horizontal Orthogonality
properties.definition: Indicative (95%-100%) range orthogonality associated to the horizontal shape and orientation in X, if different to the overall orthogonality.

properties.name: Horizontal Straightness
properties.definition: Indicative (95%-100%) range straightness associated to the horizontal shape in X, if different to the overall straightness.

properties.name: Horizontal Tolerance
properties.definition: Indicative (95%-100%) range tolerance associated to the horizontal shape and position in X, if different to the overall tolerance.

properties.name: Orthogonal Orthogonality
properties.definition: Indicative (95%-100%) range orthogonality associated to the horizontal shape and orientation in Y, if different to the overall orthogonality.

properties.name: Orthogonal Straightness
properties.definition: Indicative (95%-100%) range straightness associated to the horizontal shape in Y, if different to the overall straightness.

properties.name: Orthogonal Tolerance
properties.definition: Indicative (95%-100%) range tolerance associated to the horizontal shape and position in Y, if different to the overall tolerance.

properties.name: Overall Orthogonality
properties.definition: Indicative (95%-100%) range orthogonality associated to the intended shape and orientation in XYZ.

properties.name: Overall Straightness
properties.definition: Indicative (95%-100%) range straightness associated to the intended shape.

properties.name: Overall Tolerance
properties.definition: Indicative (95%-100%) range tolerance associated to the intended shape and position in XYZ.

properties.name: Planar Flat Ness
properties.definition: Indicative (95%-100%) range flatness associated to the intended shape and position in XYZ.

properties.name: Side Flat Ness
properties.definition: Indicative (95%-100%) range flatness associated to the side surface in YZ, if different to the overall flatness.

properties.name: Tolerance Basis
properties.definition: Indication of the basis of the tolerance requirement

properties.name: Tolerance Description
properties.definition: General description of the tolerance associated to the element or feature, its source and implications.

properties.name: Vertical Orthogonality
properties.definition: Indicative (95%-100%) range orthogonality associated to the vertical shape and orientation in Z, if different to the overall orthogonality.

properties.name: Vertical Straightness
properties.definition: Indicative (95%-100%) range straightness associated to the vertical shape in Z, if different to the overall straightness.

properties.name: Vertical Tolerance
properties.definition: Indicative (95%-100%) range tolerance associated to the vertical shape and position in Z, if different to the overall tolerance.

properties.name: Horizontal Uncertainty
properties.definition: Indicative (95%-100%) range diameter associated to the vertical shape and position in X, if different to the linear uncertainty.

properties.name: Linear Uncertainty
properties.definition: Indicative (95%-100%) range diameter associated to the overall shape and position in XYZ.

properties.name: Orthogonal Uncertainty
properties.definition: Indicative (95%-100%) range diameter associated to the horizontal shape and position in Y, if different to the horizontal uncertainty.

properties.name: Uncertainty Basis
properties.definition: Indication of the basis of the uncertainty

properties.name: Uncertainty Description
properties.definition: General description of the uncertainty associated to the element or feature, its source and implications.

properties.name: Vertical Uncertainty
properties.definition: Indicative (95%-100%) range diameter associated to the vertical shape and position in Z, if different to the linear uncertainty.

properties.name: Exclusions
properties.definition: Items, conditions or actions that may be excluded from the warranty or that may cause the warranty to become void.

properties.name: Is Extended Warranty
properties.definition: Indication of whether this is an extended warranty whose duration is greater than that normally assigned to an artefact (=TRUE) or not (= FALSE).

properties.name: Point of Contact
properties.definition: The organization that should be contacted for action under the terms of the warranty. Note that the role of the organization (manufacturer, supplier, installer etc.) is determined by the IfcActorRole attribute of IfcOrganization.

properties.name: Warranty Content
properties.definition: The content of the warranty.

properties.name: Warranty Identifier
properties.definition: The identifier assigned to a warranty.

properties.name: Warranty Period
properties.definition: The time duration during which a manufacturer or supplier guarantees or warrants the performance of an artefact.

properties.name: Warranty Start Date
properties.definition: The date on which the warranty commences.

properties.name: Gross Surface Area
properties.definition: Total gross area of the object, normally generated as perimeter * length + 2 * cross section area. It is the sum of [[OuterSurfaceArea]] + (2 x [[CrossSectionArea]]) and shall only be given, if the [[OuterSurfaceArea]] and [[CrossSectionArea]] cannot be established separately.

properties.name: Gross Volume
properties.definition: Total gross volume of the object. Openings, recesses, enclosed objects and projections are not taken into account.

properties.name: Net Surface Area
properties.definition: Net surface area of the object, normally generated as perimeter * length + 2 * cross section area taking into account possible processing features (cut-out's, etc.) or openings and recesses.

properties.name: Net Volume
properties.definition: Total net volume of the object, taking into account possible processing features (cut-out's, etc.) or openings and recesses.

properties.name: Surface Genus After Features
properties.definition: The Surface Genus of the evaluated representation items after applying product-level geometric features such as openings and projections.Surface Genus is a topological measure that represents the number of 'holes' or 'handles' on a surface. For example, a sphere has genus 0, and a torus has genus 1.

properties.name: Surface Genus Before Features
properties.definition: The Surface Genus of the evaluated representation items before applying product-level geometric features such as openings and projections.Surface Genus is a topological measure that represents the number of 'holes' or 'handles' on a surface. For example, a sphere has genus 0, and a torus has genus 1.

properties.name: Gross Weight
properties.definition: Total Gross [[Weight]] of the object without any add-on parts and not taking into account possible processing features (cut-out's, etc.) or openings and recesses.

entities.name: Electric Flow Storage Device
entities.definition: An electric flow storage device is a device in which electrical energy is stored and from which energy may be progressively released.

predefinedTypes.name: Battery
predefinedTypes.definition: A device for storing energy in chemical form so that it can be released as electrical energy.

predefinedTypes.name: Capacitor
predefinedTypes.definition: A device that stores electric charge when an external power supply is present using the electrical property of capacitance. Two-terminal device characterized essentially by its capacitance.;definition from IEC 60050 151-13-28.

predefinedTypes.name: Capacitorbank
predefinedTypes.definition: A device that stores electrical energy when an external power supply is present using the electrical property of capacitance.

predefinedTypes.name: Compensator
predefinedTypes.definition: A device that is used to fix or adjust the parameter of electric energy, such as voltage loss, power factor and so on.

predefinedTypes.name: Harmonic Filter
predefinedTypes.definition: A device that constantly injects currents that precisely correspond to the harmonic components drawn by the load.

predefinedTypes.name: Inductor
predefinedTypes.definition: A device used in circuits or power systems due to their inductance, acting as a component of electric storage device.

predefinedTypes.name: Inductor Bank
predefinedTypes.definition: A device that stores electrical energy in a magnetic field using electrical property of inductance.

predefinedTypes.name: Recharger
predefinedTypes.definition: A recharger or battery charger is a device used to put energy into a secondary cell or rechargeable battery by forcing an electric current through it.

predefinedTypes.name: UPS
predefinedTypes.definition: A device that provides a time limited alternative source of power supply in the event of failure of the main supply.

properties.name: Description
properties.definition: Optional description, provided for exchanging informative comments.

properties.name: Element Type
properties.definition: The type denotes a particular type that indicates the object further. The use has to be established at the level of instantiable subtypes. In particular it holds the user defined type, if the enumeration of the attribute 'PredefinedType' is set to [[USERDEFINED]].

properties.name: Global ID
properties.definition: Assignment of a globally unique identifier within the entire software world.

properties.name: Name
properties.definition: Optional name for use by the participating software systems or users. For some subtypes of [[IfcRoot]] the insertion of the [[Name]] attribute may be required. This would be enforced by a where rule.

properties.name: Object Type
properties.definition: The type denotes a particular type that indicates the object further. The use has to be established at the level of instantiable subtypes. In particular it holds the user defined type, if the enumeration of the attribute PredefinedType is set to [[USERDEFINED]] or when the concrete entity instantiated does not have a PredefinedType attribute. The latter is the case in some exceptional leaf classes and when instantiating [[IfcBuiltElement]] directly.

properties.name: Tag
properties.definition: The tag (or label) identifier at the particular instance of a product, e.g. the serial number, or the position number. It is the identifier at the occurrence level.

properties.name: Assessment Condition
properties.definition: The overall condition of a product based on an assessment of the contributions to the overall condition made by the various criteria considered. The meanings given to the values of assessed condition should be agreed and documented by local agreements. For instance, is overall condition measured on a scale of 1 - 10 or by assigning names such as Good, OK, Poor.

properties.name: Assessment Date
properties.definition: Date on which the overall condition is assessed

properties.name: Assessment Description
properties.definition: Qualitative description of the condition.

properties.name: Assessment Frequency
properties.definition: Indicates how often the equipment should be assessed, to have a clear estimation on its working state, based on which the maintenance staff can decide whether it requires maintenance or requires to be updated or replaced.

properties.name: Assessment Method
properties.definition: External reference to assessment method or application used to perform the assessment.

properties.name: Assessment Type
properties.definition: [[Category]] of latest condition assessment report of the asset.

properties.name: Last Assessment Report
properties.definition: Reference to latest condition (state of health) report.

properties.name: Next Assessment Date
properties.definition: Date of next condition inspection

properties.name: Procurement Method
properties.definition: The method by which an IfcProductType/[[IfcProduct]] is acquired and installed.CFCI (meaning Contractor Furnished Contractor Installed), OFCI (meaning Owner Furnished Contractor Installed), or OFOI (meaning Owner Furnished Owner Installed).

properties.name: Specification Section Number
properties.definition: A reference number to an external contract technical specification section describing either (a) minimum performance requirements of a given IfcProductType/[[IfcProduct]] or (b) a preselection for a specific IfcProductType/[[IfcProduct]] made for this project.

properties.name: Submittal Identifer
properties.definition: The reference number to an external construction administration submittal used by the construction contractor and/or subcontractor to verify that the referenced IfcProductType/[[IfcProduct]] selection conforms with the requirements found in the referenced [[SpecificationSectionNumber]].

properties.name: Asset Identifier
properties.definition: A unique identification assigned to an asset that enables its differentiation from other assets.

properties.name: Installation Date
properties.definition: Date on which the element is installed.

properties.name: Model Number
properties.definition: The model number and/or unit designator assigned by the manufacturer of the manufactured item.

properties.name: Tag Number
properties.definition: Tag number.

properties.name: Conductor Function
properties.definition: Indicates function of the conductors to which the load is connected. Where L1, L2 and L3 represent the phase lines according to IEC 60446 notation (sometimes phase lines may be referenced by color Red, Blue, Yellow or by number 1, 2, 3 etc). Protective Earth is sometimes also known as CPC or common protective conductor. Note that for an electrical device, a set of line conductor functions may be applied.

properties.name: Earthing Style
properties.definition: Indicates the earthing style of the electric device.

properties.name: Has Protective Earth
properties.definition: Indicates whether the object has a protective earth connection (=TRUE) or not (= FALSE).

properties.name: Heat Dissipation
properties.definition: Indicates the heat dissipation of the electric device measured in power.

properties.name: Ik Code
properties.definition: IK Code according to IEC 62262 (2002) is a numeric classification for the degree of protection provided by enclosures for electrical equipment against external mechanical impacts.

properties.name: Insulation Standard Class
properties.definition: Insulation standard classes provides basic protection information against electric shock. Defines levels of insulation required in terms of constructional requirements (creepage and clearance distances) and electrical requirements (compliance with electric strength tests). Basic insulation is considered to be shorted under single fault conditions. The actual values required depend on the working voltage to which the insulation is subjected, as well as other factors. Also indicates whether the electrical device has a protective earth connection.

properties.name: IP Code
properties.definition: IP Code, the International Protection Marking, IEC 60529), classifies and rates the degree of protection provided against intrusion.

properties.name: Nominal Frequency Range
properties.definition: The upper and lower limits of frequency for which the operation of the device is certified.

properties.name: Nominal Power Consumption
properties.definition: Nominal total power consumption.

properties.name: Number of Poles
properties.definition: Number of poles that the object would affect.

properties.name: Number of Power Supply Ports
properties.definition: Indicates the number of power supply ports of the electric device.

properties.name: Power
properties.definition: The actual power and operable range.

properties.name: Power Factor
properties.definition: [[Power]] factor; usually as ratio.

properties.name: Rated Current
properties.definition: The current that a device is designed to handle.

properties.name: Rated Voltage
properties.definition: The range of allowed voltage that a device is certified to handle. The upper bound of this value is the maximum.

properties.name: Electro Magnetic Standards Compliance
properties.definition: Information about compliance with regard to electro magnetic related standards.

properties.name: Explosive Atmosphere Standards Compliance
properties.definition: Information about compliance with regard to explosive atmosphere related standards.

properties.name: Fire P Roofing Standards Compliance
properties.definition: Information about compliance with regard to fire proofing related standards.

properties.name: Lightning Protection Standards Compliance
properties.definition: Information about compliance with regard to lightning protection related standards.

properties.name: Connected Conductor Function
properties.definition: [[Function]] of the conductors to which the load is connected.

properties.name: Earth Fault 1Pole Maximum State
properties.definition: Maximum 1 pole earth fault current provided at the point of supply i.e. the fault between 1 phase and PE/PEN.

properties.name: Earth Fault 1Pole Minimum State
properties.definition: Minimum 1 pole earth fault current provided at the point of supply i.e. the fault between 1 phase and PE/PEN.

properties.name: Earth Fault 1Pole Power Factor Maximum State
properties.definition: [[Power]] factor of the maximum 1 pole earth fault current provided at the point of supply i.e. the fault between 1 phase and PE/PEN.

properties.name: Earth Fault 1Pole Power Factor Minimum State
properties.definition: [[Power]] factor of the minimum 1 pole earth fault current provided at the point of supply i.e. the fault between 1 phase and PE/PEN.

properties.name: Maximum Insulated Voltage
properties.definition: The max voltage that the insulation would operate normally

properties.name: Nominal Frequency
properties.definition: The nominal frequency of the supply.

properties.name: Nominal Supply Voltage
properties.definition: The nominal voltage of the supply.

properties.name: Nominal Supply Voltage Off Set
properties.definition: The maximum and minimum allowed voltage of the supply e.g. boundaries of 380V/440V may be applied for a nominal voltage of 400V.

properties.name: Power Capacity
properties.definition: [[Power]] capacity of the equipment

properties.name: Rated Capacitance
properties.definition: [[Capacitance]] value determined under specified conditions and declared by the manufacturer.

properties.name: Short Circuit 1Pole Maximum State
properties.definition: Maximum 1 pole short circuit current provided at the point of supply i.e. the fault between 1 phase and N.

properties.name: Short Circuit 1Pole Minimum State
properties.definition: Minimum 1 pole short circuit current provided at the point of supply i.e. the fault between 1 phase and N.

properties.name: Short Circuit 1Pole Power Factor Maximum State
properties.definition: [[Power]] factor of the maximum 1 pole short circuit current provided at the point of supply i.e. the fault between 1 phase and N.

properties.name: Short Circuit 1Pole Power Factor Minimum State
properties.definition: [[Power]] factor of the minimum 1 pole short circuit current provided at the point of supply i.e. the fault between 1 phase and N.

properties.name: Short Circuit 2Pole Minimum State
properties.definition: Minimum 2 pole short circuit current provided at the point of supply.

properties.name: Short Circuit 2Pole Power Factor Minimum State
properties.definition: [[Power]] factor of the minimum 2 pole short circuit current provided at the point of supply.

properties.name: Short Circuit 3Pole Maximum State
properties.definition: Maximum 3 pole short circuit current provided at the point of supply.

properties.name: Short Circuit 3Pole Power Factor Maximum State
properties.definition: [[Power]] factor of the maximum 3 pole short circuit current provided at the point of supply.

properties.name: Status
properties.definition: [[Status]] of the element, predominately used in renovation or retrofitting projects. The status can be assigned to as 'New' - element designed as new addition, 'Existing' - element exists and remains, 'Demolish' - element existed but is to be demolished, 'Temporary' - element will exists only temporary (like a temporary support structure).

allowedValues.description: 'Demolish' - element existed but is to be demolished
The status can be assigned to as 'New' - element designed as new addition
'Temporary' - element will exists only temporary (like a temporary support structure)

properties.name: Cyclic Path
properties.definition: angle table of the kinematic behaviour.

properties.name: Cyclic Range
properties.definition: Identifies the angular range of the kinematic behaviour

properties.name: Linear Path
properties.definition: distance table of the kinematic behaviour.

properties.name: Linear Range
properties.definition: Identifies the linear range of the kinematic behaviour.

properties.name: Maximum Angular Velocity
properties.definition: Identifies the maximum angular velocity of the kinematic behaviour.

properties.name: Maximum Constant Speed
properties.definition: Identifies the maximum constant speed over the kinematic path.

properties.name: Minimum Time
properties.definition: Identifies the minimum time for the kinematic behaviour.

properties.name: Nominal Height
properties.definition: The nominal height of the object. The size information is provided in addition to the shape representation and the geometric parameters used within. In cases of inconsistency between the geometric parameters and the size properties, provided in the attached property set, the geometric parameters take precedence.

properties.name: Nominal Length
properties.definition: The nominal overall length of the object. The size information is provided in addition to the shape representation and the geometric parameters used within. In case of inconsistency between the geometric parameters and the size properties, provided in the attached property set, the geometric parameters take precedence.

properties.name: Nominal Width
properties.definition: The nominal overall width of the object. The size information is provided in addition to the shape representation and the geometric parameters used within. In cases of inconsistency between the geometric parameters and the size properties, provided in the attached property set, the geometric parameters take precedence.

properties.name: Energy Consumption
properties.definition: Annual energy consumption requirement

properties.name: Energy Conversion Efficiency
properties.definition: Measure of the efficiency of conversion of fuel energy to mechanical energy

properties.name: Energy Source Label
properties.definition: [[Type]] of energy source e.g. [[Electricity]], Diesel, LPG etc. utilised by the element.

properties.name: Power Demand
properties.definition: [[Power]] demand of the element

properties.name: Maximum Atmospheric Pressure
properties.definition: Maximum level of atmospheric pressure that the equipment can operate effectively in.

properties.name: Maximum Rain Intensity
properties.definition: Maximum level of rain intensity that the equipment can operate effectively in. It is usually measured in millimeter per hour (mm/h).

properties.name: Maximum Solar Radiation
properties.definition: Maximum level of solar irradiance that the equipment can operate effectively in. This is usually tested and measured by a national or international standard. The value indicates power density measured in watt per square meter (w/m2).

properties.name: Maximum Wind Speed
properties.definition: Maximum resistance to wind load exposure.

properties.name: Operational Temperature Range
properties.definition: The temperature range in which the device operates normally.

properties.name: Reference Air Relative Humidity
properties.definition: Measurement of the ratio of water vapor in the air.

properties.name: Reference Environment Temperature
properties.definition: Ideal temperature range.

properties.name: Salt Mist Level
properties.definition: Maximum level of salt mist that the equipment can operate effectively in. It is provided according to an international or national standard.

properties.name: Seismic Resistance
properties.definition: Maximum magnitude of earthquake that the equipment complies with. The value indicates earthquake intensity measured in Richter scale.

properties.name: Smoke Level
properties.definition: Maximum level of smoke that the equipment complies with. It is provided according to an international or national standard.

properties.name: Storage Temperature Range
properties.definition: Allowed storage temperature range that the element complies with.

properties.definition: Rate of emission of carbon dioxide

properties.name: Nitrogen Oxides Emissions
properties.definition: Rate of emission of nitrogen oxides

properties.name: Noise Emissions
properties.definition: Level of sound emission

properties.name: Particulate Matter Emissions
properties.definition: Rate of emission of particulate matter

properties.name: Sulphur Dioxide Emissions
properties.definition: Rate of emission of sulphur dioxide

properties.name: Gross Surface Area
properties.definition: Total gross area of the object, normally generated as perimeter * length + 2 * cross section area. It is the sum of [[OuterSurfaceArea]] + (2 x [[CrossSectionArea]]) and shall only be given, if the [[OuterSurfaceArea]] and [[CrossSectionArea]] cannot be established separately.

properties.name: Gross Volume
properties.definition: Total gross volume of the object. Openings, recesses, enclosed objects and projections are not taken into account.

properties.name: Net Surface Area
properties.definition: Net surface area of the object, normally generated as perimeter * length + 2 * cross section area taking into account possible processing features (cut-out's, etc.) or openings and recesses.

properties.name: Net Volume
properties.definition: Total net volume of the object, taking into account possible processing features (cut-out's, etc.) or openings and recesses.

properties.name: Surface Genus After Features
properties.definition: The Surface Genus of the evaluated representation items after applying product-level geometric features such as openings and projections.Surface Genus is a topological measure that represents the number of 'holes' or 'handles' on a surface. For example, a sphere has genus 0, and a torus has genus 1.

properties.name: Surface Genus Before Features
properties.definition: The Surface Genus of the evaluated representation items before applying product-level geometric features such as openings and projections.Surface Genus is a topological measure that represents the number of 'holes' or 'handles' on a surface. For example, a sphere has genus 0, and a torus has genus 1.

properties.name: Gross Weight
properties.definition: Total Gross [[Weight]] of the object without any add-on parts and not taking into account possible processing features (cut-out's, etc.) or openings and recesses.

properties.name: Description

properties.name: Global ID
properties.definition: Assignment of a globally unique identifier within the entire software world.

properties.name: Name
properties.definition: Optional name for use by the participating software systems or users. For some subtypes of [[IfcRoot]] the insertion of the [[Name]] attribute may be required. This would be enforced by a where rule.

properties.name: Object Type

In particular it holds the user defined type, if the enumeration of the attribute PredefinedType is set to [[USERDEFINED]] or when the concrete entity instantiated does not have a PredefinedType attribute. properties.name: Tag

properties.definition: The overall condition of a product based on an assessment of the contributions to the overall condition made by the various criteria considered. The meanings given to the values of assessed condition should be agreed and documented by local agreements. For instance, is overall condition measured on a scale of 1 - 10 or by assigning names such as Good, OK, Poor.

properties.name: Assessment Description

Where L1, L2 and L3 represent the phase lines according to IEC 60446 notation (sometimes phase lines may be referenced by color Red, Blue, Yellow or by number 1, 2, 3 etc). Protective Earth is sometimes also known as CPC or common protective conductor. Note that for an electrical device, a set of line conductor functions may be applied.

Defines levels of insulation required in terms of constructional requirements (creepage and clearance distances) and electrical requirements (compliance with electric strength tests). Basic insulation is considered to be shorted under single fault conditions. The actual values required depend on the working voltage to which the insulation is subjected, as well as other factors. Also indicates whether the electrical device has a protective earth connection.

properties.name: IP Code

properties.name: Exclusions

properties.name: Point of Contact
properties.definition: The organization that should be contacted for action under the terms of the warranty. Note that the role of the organization (manufacturer, supplier, installer etc.) is determined by the IfcActorRole attribute of IfcOrganization.

properties.name: Warranty Content

properties.name: Warranty Identifier

properties.name: Warranty Period

properties.name: Warranty Start Date
