entities.name: Valve
entities.definition: A valve is used in a building services piping distribution system to control or modulate the flow of the fluid.

predefinedTypes.name: Air Release
predefinedTypes.definition: Valve used to release air from a pipe or fitting.

predefinedTypes.name: Anti Vacuum
predefinedTypes.definition: Valve that opens to admit air if the pressure falls below atmospheric pressure.

predefinedTypes.name: Change Over
predefinedTypes.definition: Valve that enables flow to be switched between pipelines (3 or 4 port).

predefinedTypes.name: Check
predefinedTypes.definition: Valve that permits water to flow in one direction only and is enclosed when there is no flow (2 port).

predefinedTypes.name: Commissioning
predefinedTypes.definition: Valve used to facilitate commissioning of a system (2 port).

predefinedTypes.name: Diverting
predefinedTypes.definition: Valve that enables flow to be diverted from one branch of a pipeline to another (3 port).

predefinedTypes.name: Double Check
predefinedTypes.definition: An assembly that incorporates two valves used to prevent backflow.

predefinedTypes.name: Double Regulating
predefinedTypes.definition: Valve used to facilitate regulation of fluid flow in a system.

predefinedTypes.name: Draw Off Cock
predefinedTypes.definition: A valve used to remove fluid from a piping system.

predefinedTypes.name: Faucet
predefinedTypes.definition: Faucet valve typically used as a flow discharge.

predefinedTypes.name: Flushing
predefinedTypes.definition: Valve that flushes a predetermined quantity of water to cleanse a toilet, urinal, etc.

predefinedTypes.name: Gas Cock
predefinedTypes.definition: Valve that is used for controlling the flow of gas.

predefinedTypes.name: Gas Tap
predefinedTypes.definition: Gas tap typically used for venting or discharging gas from a system.

predefinedTypes.name: Isolating
predefinedTypes.definition: Valve that closes off flow in a pipeline.

predefinedTypes.name: Mixing
predefinedTypes.definition: Valve that enables flow from two branches of a pipeline to be mixed together (3 port).

predefinedTypes.name: Pressure Reducing
predefinedTypes.definition: Valve that reduces the pressure of a fluid immediately downstream of its position in a pipeline to a preselected value or by a predetermined ratio.

predefinedTypes.name: Pressure Relief
predefinedTypes.definition: Spring or weight loaded valve that automatically discharges to a safe place fluid that has built up to excessive pressure in pipes or fittings.

predefinedTypes.name: Regulating
predefinedTypes.definition: Valve used to facilitate regulation of fluid flow in a system.

predefinedTypes.name: Safety Cut Off
predefinedTypes.definition: Valve that closes under the action of a safety mechanism such as a drop weight, solenoid etc.

predefinedTypes.name: Steamtrap
predefinedTypes.definition: Valve that restricts flow of steam while allowing condensate to pass through.

predefinedTypes.name: Stop Cock
predefinedTypes.definition: An isolating valve used on a domestic water service.

properties.definition: Total gross area of the object, normally generated as perimeter * length + 2 * cross section area. properties.name: Gross Volume
properties.definition: Total gross volume of the object. Openings, recesses, enclosed objects and projections are not taken into account.

properties.definition: Net surface area of the object, normally generated as perimeter * length + 2 * cross section area taking into account possible processing features (cut-out's, etc.) or openings and recesses.

properties.name: Net Volume
properties.definition: Total net volume of the object, taking into account possible processing features (cut-out's, etc.) or openings and recesses.

properties.definition: Assignment of a globally unique identifier within the entire software world.

properties.definition: The type denotes a particular type that indicates the object further. The use has to be established at the level of instantiable subtypes. In particular it holds the user defined type, if the enumeration of the attribute PredefinedType is set to [[USERDEFINED]] or when the concrete entity instantiated does not have a PredefinedType attribute. The latter is the case in some exceptional leaf classes and when instantiating [[IfcBuiltElement]] directly.

entities.name: Vibration Damper
entities.definition: A vibration damper is a device used to minimize the effects of vibration in a structure by dissipating kinetic energy. The damper may be passive (elastic, frictional, inertia) or active (in a system using sensors and actuators).

predefinedTypes.name: Axial Yield
predefinedTypes.definition: A displacement dependent type damper in which the resistance force generated is determined by the plastic strain amount utilizing the plastic deformation of the steel material. The axial yield type is a damper that yields energy by absorbing the steel material against deformation in the axial direction, that is, in the direction of expansion and contraction.

predefinedTypes.name: Bending Yield
predefinedTypes.definition: A displacement dependent type damper in which the resistance force generated is determined by the plastic strain amount utilizing the plastic deformation of the steel material. The bending yield type is a damper, which yields steel material by bending.

predefinedTypes.name: Friction
predefinedTypes.definition: The friction type is a damper utilizing friction acting on the contact surface of a material.

predefinedTypes.name: Rubber
predefinedTypes.definition: The rubber mold is a damper that absorbs energy by utilizing deformation of laminated rubber. The difference between the seismic isolation bearing and the rubber type damper is whether or not to support the weight of the upper structures. The rubber damper does not transmit the weight of the upper structures to the sub structure.

predefinedTypes.name: Shear Yield
predefinedTypes.definition: A displacement dependent type damper in which the resistance force generated is determined by the plastic strain amount utilizing the plastic deformation of the steel material. The shear yield type is a damper, which causes the steel material to yield for deformation in the direction perpendicular to the member.

predefinedTypes.name: Viscous
predefinedTypes.definition: The viscous type is a damper that absorbs energy by utilizing the resistance of a viscous body.

properties.name: Gross Surface Area
properties.definition: Total gross area of the object, normally generated as perimeter * length + 2 * cross section area. It is the sum of [[OuterSurfaceArea]] + (2 x [[CrossSectionArea]]) and shall only be given, if the [[OuterSurfaceArea]] and [[CrossSectionArea]] cannot be established separately.

properties.name: Gross Volume
properties.definition: Total gross volume of the object. Openings, recesses, enclosed objects and projections are not taken into account.

properties.name: Net Surface Area
properties.definition: Net surface area of the object, normally generated as perimeter * length + 2 * cross section area taking into account possible processing features (cut-out's, etc.) or openings and recesses.

properties.name: Net Volume
properties.definition: Total net volume of the object, taking into account possible processing features (cut-out's, etc.) or openings and recesses.

properties.name: Surface Genus After Features
properties.definition: The Surface Genus of the evaluated representation items after applying product-level geometric features such as openings and projections.Surface Genus is a topological measure that represents the number of 'holes' or 'handles' on a surface. For example, a sphere has genus 0, and a torus has genus 1.

properties.name: Surface Genus Before Features
properties.definition: The Surface Genus of the evaluated representation items before applying product-level geometric features such as openings and projections.Surface Genus is a topological measure that represents the number of 'holes' or 'handles' on a surface. For example, a sphere has genus 0, and a torus has genus 1.

entities.name: Voiding Feature
entities.definition: A voiding feature is a modification of an element which reduces its volume. Such a feature may be manufactured in different ways, for example by cutting, drilling, or milling of members made of various materials, or by inlays into the formwork of cast members made of materials such as concrete.

predefinedTypes.name: Chamfer
predefinedTypes.definition: A skewed plane end cut, removing material only across a part of the profile of the voided element.

predefinedTypes.name: Cutout
predefinedTypes.definition: An internal cutout (creating an opening) or external cutout (creating a recess) of arbitrary shape. The edges between cutting planes may be overcut or undercut, i.e. rounded.

predefinedTypes.name: Edge
predefinedTypes.definition: A shape modification along an edge of the element with the edge length as the predominant dimension of the feature, and feature profile dimensions which are typically much smaller than the edge length. Can for example be a chamfer edge (differentiated from a chamfer by its ratio of dimensions and thus usually manufactured differently), rounded edge (a convex edge feature), or fillet edge (a concave edge feature).

predefinedTypes.name: Hole
predefinedTypes.definition: A circular or slotted or threaded hole, typically but not necessarily of smaller dimension than what would be considered a cutout.

predefinedTypes.name: Miter
predefinedTypes.definition: A skewed plane end cut, removing material across the entire profile of the voided element.

predefinedTypes.name: Notch
predefinedTypes.definition: An external cutout of with a mostly rectangular cutting profile. The edges between cutting planes may be overcut or undercut, i.e. rounded.

entities.name: Wall
entities.definition: The wall represents a vertical construction that may bound or subdivide spaces. Wall are usually vertical, or nearly vertical, planar elements, often designed to bear structural loads. A wall is however not required to be load bearing.

predefinedTypes.name: Elemented Wall
predefinedTypes.definition: A stud wall framed with studs and faced with sheetings, sidings, wallboard, or plasterwork.

predefinedTypes.name: Movable
predefinedTypes.definition: A movable wall that is either movable, such as folding wall or a sliding wall, or can be easily removed as a removable partitioning or mounting wall. Movable walls do normally not define space boundaries and often belong to the furnishing system.

predefinedTypes.name: Parapet
predefinedTypes.definition: A wall-like barrier to protect human or vehicle from falling, or to prevent the spread of fires. Often designed at the edge of balconies, terraces or roofs, or along edges of bridges.

predefinedTypes.name: Partitioning
predefinedTypes.definition: A wall designed to partition spaces that often has a light-weight, sandwich-like construction (e.g. using gypsum board). Partitioning walls are normally non load bearing.

predefinedTypes.name: Plumbing Wall
predefinedTypes.definition: A pier, or enclosure, or encasement, normally used to enclose plumbing in sanitary rooms. Such walls often do not extend to the ceiling.

predefinedTypes.name: Polygonal
predefinedTypes.definition: A polygonal wall, extruded vertically, where the wall thickness varies along the wall path.

predefinedTypes.name: Retaining Wall
predefinedTypes.definition: A supporting wall used to protect against soil layers behind. Special types of a retaining wall may be e.g. Gabion wall and Grib wall. Examples of retaining walls are wing wall, headwall, stem wall, pierwall and protecting wall.

predefinedTypes.name: Shear
predefinedTypes.definition: A wall designed to withstand shear loads. Examples of shear wall are diaphragms inside a box girder, typically on a pier, to resist lateral forces and transfer them to the support.

predefinedTypes.name: Solid Wall
predefinedTypes.definition: A massive wall construction for the wall core being the single layer or having multiple layers attached. Such walls are often masonry or concrete walls (both cast in-situ or precast) that are load bearing and fire protecting.

predefinedTypes.name: Standard
predefinedTypes.definition: A standard wall, extruded vertically with a constant thickness along the wall path.;

predefinedTypes.name: Wave Wall
predefinedTypes.definition: Protective wall or screen to block overtopping and impact of waves across a breakwater

properties.name: Global Trade Item Number
properties.definition: The Global Trade Item Number (GTIN) is an identifier for trade items developed by GS1 (www.gs1.org).

properties.name: Manufacturer
properties.definition: The organization that manufactured and/or assembled the item.

properties.name: Model Label
properties.definition: The descriptive model name of the product model (or product line) as assigned by the manufacturer of the manufactured item.

properties.name: Model Reference
properties.definition: The model number or designator of the product model (or product line) as assigned by the manufacturer of the manufactured item.

properties.name: Operational Document
properties.definition: [[Manufacturer]]'s operational document

properties.name: Performance Certificate
properties.definition: [[Manufacturer]]'s performance certificate

properties.name: Production Year
properties.definition: The year of production of the manufactured item.

properties.name: Safety Document
properties.definition: [[Manufacturer]]'s safety document

properties.name: Actual Erection Date
properties.definition: Date erected.

properties.name: Actual Production Date
properties.definition: Production date (stripped from form).

properties.name: As Built Location Number
properties.definition: Defines a unique location within a structure, the slot into which the piece was installed. Where pieces share the same piece mark, they can be interchanged. The value is only known after erection.

properties.name: Piece Mark
properties.definition: Defines a unique piece for production purposes. All pieces with the same piece mark value are identical and interchangeable. The piece mark may be composed of sub-parts that have specific locally defined meaning (e.g. B-1A may denote a beam, of generic type 1 and specific shape A).

properties.name: Production Lot ID
properties.definition: The manufacturer's production lot identifier.

properties.name: Serial Number
properties.definition: The manufacturer's serial number assigned to an occurrence of a product.

properties.name: Type Designation
properties.definition: [[Type]] designator for the element. The content depends on local standards. Eg. 'Bull nose', 'Half batter', 'Dropper', 'Chamfer' etc

properties.name: Batter at End
properties.definition: The angle, in radians, by which the formwork at the ending face of a piece is to be rotated from the vertical in order to compensate for the rotation of the face that will occur once the piece is stripped from its form, inducing camber due to eccentric prestressing.

properties.name: Batter at Start
properties.definition: The angle, in radians, by which the formwork at the starting face of a piece is to be rotated from the vertical in order to compensate for the rotation of the face that will occur once the piece is stripped from its form, inducing camber due to eccentric prestressing.

properties.name: Camber at Midspan
properties.definition: The camber deflection, measured from the midpoint of a cambered face of a piece to the midpoint of the chord joining the ends of the same face,, divided by the original (nominal) straight length of the face of the piece.

properties.name: Corner Chamfer
properties.definition: The chamfer in the corners of the precast element. The chamfer is presumed to be equal in both directions.

properties.name: Design Location Number
properties.definition: Defines a unique location within a structure, the slot for which the piece was designed.

properties.name: Form Strip Ping Strength
properties.definition: The minimum required compressive strength of the concrete at form stripping time.

properties.name: Hollow Core Plug Ging
properties.definition: they may be left open, closed with a plug, or sealed with cast concrete. Values would be,'Unplugged', 'Plugged', 'SealedWithConcrete'. This property applies to hollow core slabs only.

properties.name: Initial Tension
properties.definition: The initial stress of the tendon. This property applies to prestressed concrete elements only.

properties.name: Lifting Strength
properties.definition: The minimum required compressive strength of the concrete when the concrete element is lifted.

properties.name: Manufacturing Tolerance Class
properties.definition: Classification designation of the manufacturing tolerances according to local standards.

properties.name: Minimum Allowable Support Length
properties.definition: The minimum allowable support length.

properties.name: Piece Mark
properties.definition: Defines a unique piece for production purposes. All pieces with the same piece mark value are identical and interchangeable. The piece mark may be composed of sub-parts that have specific locally defined meaning (e.g. B-1A may denote a beam, of generic type 1 and specific shape A).

properties.name: Release Strength
properties.definition: The minimum required compressive strength of the concrete when the tendon stress is released. This property applies to prestressed concrete elements only.

properties.name: Shortening
properties.definition: The ratio of the distance by which a precast piece is shortened after release from its form (due to compression induced by prestressing) to its original (nominal) length.

properties.name: Support During Transport Description
properties.definition: Textual description of how the concrete element is supported during transportation.

properties.name: Support During Transport Doc Reference
properties.definition: Reference to an external document defining how the concrete element is supported during transportation.

properties.name: Tendon Relaxation
properties.definition: The maximum allowable relaxation of the tendon (usually expressed as %/[[1000]] h).This property applies to prestressed concrete elements only.

properties.name: Transportation Strength
properties.definition: The minimum required compressive strength of the concrete required for transportation.

properties.name: Twisting
properties.definition: The angle, in radians, through which the end face of a precast piece is rotated with respect to its starting face, along its longitudinal axis, as a result of non-aligned supports. This measure is also termed the warping angle.

properties.name: Type Designation
properties.definition: [[Type]] designator for the element. The content depends on local standards. Eg. 'Bull nose', 'Half batter', 'Dropper', 'Chamfer' etc

properties.name: Bar Al Location Type
properties.definition: Defines the type of the reinforcement bar allocation.

properties.name: Description
properties.definition: Optional description, provided for exchanging informative comments.

properties.name: Horizontal Bar Pitch
properties.definition: The pitch length of the horizontal bar.

properties.name: Spacing Bar Pitch
properties.definition: The pitch length of the spacing bar.

properties.name: Vertical Bar Pitch
properties.definition: The pitch length of the vertical bar.

properties.name: Mean Time to Repair
properties.definition: Mean time to repair.

properties.name: Repair Content
properties.definition: Content of repair, reason and nature can be given, e.g. display faults, communication failure, display exchange.

properties.name: Repair Date
properties.definition: Date on which the last repair is done on the asset.

properties.name: Associated Activity
properties.definition: An indication or link to any associated activity or process that may trigger the hazard. If used directly on an annotation or semantic object. for an alternative see group use encoding template

properties.name: Associated Location
properties.definition: An indication or link to any associated location or space that may trigger the hazard. If used directly on an annotation or semantic object. for an alternative see group use encoding template

properties.name: Associated Product
properties.definition: An indication or link to any associated product or material that may trigger the hazard. If used directly on an annotation or semantic object. for an alternative see group use encoding template

properties.name: Mitigated Risk Consequence
properties.definition: Identifies the consequence of the hazard given the planned mitigation.

properties.name: Mitigated Risk Likelihood
properties.definition: Identifies the likelihood of the hazard given the planned mitigation.

properties.name: Mitigated Risk Significance
properties.definition: Identifies the significance of the risk given the mitigation of likelihood and consequence.

properties.name: Mitigation Planned
properties.definition: The planned (agreed and irrevocable) mitigation of the likelhood and consequences of the hazard.

properties.name: Mitigation Proposed
properties.definition: Any proposed, but not yet agreed and irrevocable, mitigation of the likelhood and consequences of the hazard.

properties.name: Nature of Risk
properties.definition: A description of the generic nature of the context or hazard that might be encountered.

properties.name: Risk Assessment Methodology
properties.definition: An indication or link to the chosen risk assessment methodology, for example PAS1192-6 or a chosen ISO13100 annex.

properties.name: Risk Name
properties.definition: A locally unique identifier for the risk entry that can be used to track the development and mitigation of the risk throughout the project life cycle

properties.name: Risk Type
properties.definition: Identifies the predefined types of risk from which the type required may be set.

properties.name: Unmitigated Risk Consequence
properties.definition: Identifies the consequence of the hazard prior to any specific mitigation.

properties.name: Unmitigated Risk Likelihood
properties.definition: Identifies the likelihood of the hazard prior to any specific mitigation.

properties.name: Unmitigated Risk Significance
properties.definition: Identifies the significance of the risk given the likelihood and consequence prior to any specific mitigation.

properties.name: Mean Time Between Failure
properties.definition: The average time duration between instances of failure of a product.

properties.name: Service Life Duration
properties.definition: The length or duration of a service life.The lower bound indicates pessimistic service life, the upper bound indicates optimistic service life, and the setpoint indicates the typical service life.

properties.name: Elevational Flat Ness
properties.definition: Indicative (95%-100%) range flatness associated to the elevational surface in ZX, if different to the overall flatness.

properties.name: Horizontal Flat Ness
properties.definition: Indicative (95%-100%) range flatness associated to the horizontal surface in XY, if different to the overall flatness.

properties.name: Horizontal Orthogonality
properties.definition: Indicative (95%-100%) range orthogonality associated to the horizontal shape and orientation in X, if different to the overall orthogonality.

properties.name: Horizontal Straightness
properties.definition: Indicative (95%-100%) range straightness associated to the horizontal shape in X, if different to the overall straightness.

properties.name: Horizontal Tolerance
properties.definition: Indicative (95%-100%) range tolerance associated to the horizontal shape and position in X, if different to the overall tolerance.

properties.name: Orthogonal Orthogonality
properties.definition: Indicative (95%-100%) range orthogonality associated to the horizontal shape and orientation in Y, if different to the overall orthogonality.

properties.name: Orthogonal Straightness
properties.definition: Indicative (95%-100%) range straightness associated to the horizontal shape in Y, if different to the overall straightness.

properties.name: Orthogonal Tolerance
properties.definition: Indicative (95%-100%) range tolerance associated to the horizontal shape and position in Y, if different to the overall tolerance.

properties.name: Overall Orthogonality
properties.definition: Indicative (95%-100%) range orthogonality associated to the intended shape and orientation in XYZ.

properties.name: Overall Straightness
properties.definition: Indicative (95%-100%) range straightness associated to the intended shape.

properties.name: Overall Tolerance
properties.definition: Indicative (95%-100%) range tolerance associated to the intended shape and position in XYZ.

properties.name: Planar Flat Ness
properties.definition: Indicative (95%-100%) range flatness associated to the intended shape and position in XYZ.

properties.name: Side Flat Ness
properties.definition: Indicative (95%-100%) range flatness associated to the side surface in YZ, if different to the overall flatness.

properties.name: Tolerance Basis
properties.definition: Indication of the basis of the tolerance requirement

properties.name: Tolerance Description
properties.definition: General description of the tolerance associated to the element or feature, its source and implications.

properties.name: Vertical Orthogonality
properties.definition: Indicative (95%-100%) range orthogonality associated to the vertical shape and orientation in Z, if different to the overall orthogonality.

properties.name: Vertical Straightness
properties.definition: Indicative (95%-100%) range straightness associated to the vertical shape in Z, if different to the overall straightness.

properties.name: Vertical Tolerance
properties.definition: Indicative (95%-100%) range tolerance associated to the vertical shape and position in Z, if different to the overall tolerance.

properties.name: Horizontal Uncertainty
properties.definition: Indicative (95%-100%) range diameter associated to the vertical shape and position in X, if different to the linear uncertainty.

properties.name: Linear Uncertainty
properties.definition: Indicative (95%-100%) range diameter associated to the overall shape and position in XYZ.

properties.name: Orthogonal Uncertainty
properties.definition: Indicative (95%-100%) range diameter associated to the horizontal shape and position in Y, if different to the horizontal uncertainty.

properties.name: Uncertainty Basis
properties.definition: Indication of the basis of the uncertainty

properties.name: Uncertainty Description
properties.definition: General description of the uncertainty associated to the element or feature, its source and implications.

properties.name: Vertical Uncertainty
properties.definition: Indicative (95%-100%) range diameter associated to the vertical shape and position in Z, if different to the linear uncertainty.

properties.name: Acoustic Rating
properties.definition: Acoustic rating for this object.; It is provided according to the national building code. It indicates the sound transmission resistance of this object by an index ratio (instead of providing full sound absorption values).

properties.name: Combustible
properties.definition: Indication whether the object is made from combustible material (TRUE) or not (FALSE).

properties.name: Compartmentation
properties.definition: Indication whether the object is designed to serve as a fire compartmentation (TRUE) or not (FALSE).

properties.name: Extend to Structure
properties.definition: Indicates whether the object extend to the structure above (TRUE) or not (FALSE).

properties.name: Fire Rating
properties.definition: Fire rating for this object. It is given according to the national fire safety classification.

properties.name: Is External
properties.definition: Indication whether the element is designed for use in the exterior (TRUE) or not (FALSE). If (TRUE) it is an external element and faces the outside of the building.

properties.name: Load Bearing
properties.definition: Indicates whether the object is intended to carry loads (TRUE) or not (FALSE).

properties.name: Status
properties.definition: [[Status]] of the element, predominately used in renovation or retrofitting projects. The status can be assigned to as 'New' - element designed as new addition, 'Existing' - element exists and remains, 'Demolish' - element existed but is to be demolished, 'Temporary' - element will exists only temporary (like a temporary support structure).

allowedValues.description: 'Demolish' - element existed but is to be demolished
The status can be assigned to as 'New' - element designed as new addition
'Temporary' - element will exists only temporary (like a temporary support structure)

properties.name: Surface Spread of Flame
properties.definition: Indication on how the flames spread around the surface,; It is given according to the national building code that governs the fire behaviour for materials.

properties.name: Thermal Transmittance
properties.definition: Thermal transmittance coefficient (U-[[Value]]) of an element, within the direction of the thermal flow (including all materials).

properties.name: Exclusions
properties.definition: Items, conditions or actions that may be excluded from the warranty or that may cause the warranty to become void.

properties.name: Is Extended Warranty
properties.definition: Indication of whether this is an extended warranty whose duration is greater than that normally assigned to an artefact (=TRUE) or not (= FALSE).

properties.name: Point of Contact
properties.definition: The organization that should be contacted for action under the terms of the warranty. Note that the role of the organization (manufacturer, supplier, installer etc.) is determined by the IfcActorRole attribute of IfcOrganization.

properties.name: Warranty Content
properties.definition: The content of the warranty.

properties.name: Warranty Identifier
properties.definition: The identifier assigned to a warranty.

properties.name: Warranty Period
properties.definition: The time duration during which a manufacturer or supplier guarantees or warrants the performance of an artefact.

properties.name: Warranty Start Date
properties.definition: The date on which the warranty commences.

properties.name: Gross Surface Area
properties.definition: Total gross area of the object, normally generated as perimeter * length + 2 * cross section area. It is the sum of [[OuterSurfaceArea]] + (2 x [[CrossSectionArea]]) and shall only be given, if the [[OuterSurfaceArea]] and [[CrossSectionArea]] cannot be established separately.

properties.name: Gross Volume
properties.definition: Total gross volume of the object. Openings, recesses, enclosed objects and projections are not taken into account.

properties.name: Net Surface Area
properties.definition: Net surface area of the object, normally generated as perimeter * length + 2 * cross section area taking into account possible processing features (cut-out's, etc.) or openings and recesses.

properties.name: Net Volume
properties.definition: Total net volume of the object, taking into account possible processing features (cut-out's, etc.) or openings and recesses.

properties.name: Surface Genus After Features
properties.definition: The Surface Genus of the evaluated representation items after applying product-level geometric features such as openings and projections.Surface Genus is a topological measure that represents the number of 'holes' or 'handles' on a surface. For example, a sphere has genus 0, and a torus has genus 1.

properties.name: Surface Genus Before Features
properties.definition: The Surface Genus of the evaluated representation items before applying product-level geometric features such as openings and projections.Surface Genus is a topological measure that represents the number of 'holes' or 'handles' on a surface. For example, a sphere has genus 0, and a torus has genus 1.

properties.name: Gross Foot Print Area
properties.definition: [[Area]] of the wall as viewed by a ground floor view, not taking any wall modifications (like recesses) into account. It is also referred to as the foot print of the wall.

properties.name: Gross Side Area
properties.definition: [[Area]] of the wall as viewed by an elevation view of the middle plane of the wall. It does not take into account any wall modifications (such as openings).

properties.name: Gross Volume
properties.definition: Total gross volume of the object. Openings, recesses, enclosed objects and projections are not taken into account.

properties.name: Gross Weight
properties.definition: Total Gross [[Weight]] of the object without any add-on parts and not taking into account possible processing features (cut-out's, etc.) or openings and recesses.

properties.name: Height
properties.definition: Characteristic height

properties.name: Length
properties.definition: The length of the object.

properties.name: Net Foot Print Area
properties.definition: [[Area]] of the wall as viewed by a ground floor view, taking all wall modifications (like recesses) into account. It is also referred to as the foot print of the wall.

properties.name: Net Side Area
properties.definition: [[Area]] of the object as viewed by an elevation view of the middle plane of the object. It does take into account all object modifications (such as openings).

properties.name: Net Volume
properties.definition: Total net volume of the object, taking into account possible processing features (cut-out's, etc.) or openings and recesses.

properties.name: Net Weight
properties.definition: Total net weight of the object without add-on parts, taking into account possible processing features (cut-out's, etc.) or openings and recesses.

properties.name: Width
properties.definition: The width of the object. Only given, if the object has constant thickness (prismatic).

entities.name: Waste Terminal
entities.definition: A waste terminal has the purpose of collecting or intercepting waste from one or more sanitary terminals or other fluid waste generating equipment and discharging it into a single waste/drainage system.

predefinedTypes.name: Floortrap
predefinedTypes.definition: Pipe fitting, set into the floor, that retains liquid to prevent the passage of foul air

predefinedTypes.name: Floor Waste
predefinedTypes.definition: Pipe fitting, set into the floor, that collects waste water and discharges it to a separate trap.

predefinedTypes.name: Gully Sump
predefinedTypes.definition: Pipe fitting or assembly of fittings to receive surface water or waste water, fitted with a grating or sealed cover.

predefinedTypes.name: Gullytrap
predefinedTypes.definition: Pipe fitting or assembly of fittings that receives surface water or waste water; fitted with a grating or sealed cover that discharges water through a trap.

predefinedTypes.name: Roofd Rain
predefinedTypes.definition: Pipe fitting, set into the roof, that collects rainwater for discharge into the rainwater system.

predefinedTypes.name: Waste Disposal Unit
predefinedTypes.definition: Electrically operated device that reduces kitchen or other waste into fragments small enough to be flushed into a drainage system.

predefinedTypes.name: Waste Trap
predefinedTypes.definition: Pipe fitting, set adjacent to a sanitary terminal, that retains liquid to prevent the passage of foul air.

properties.name: Description
properties.definition: Optional description, provided for exchanging informative comments.

properties.name: Element Type
properties.definition: The type denotes a particular type that indicates the object further. The use has to be established at the level of instantiable subtypes. In particular it holds the user defined type, if the enumeration of the attribute 'PredefinedType' is set to [[USERDEFINED]].

properties.name: Global ID
properties.definition: Assignment of a globally unique identifier within the entire software world.

properties.name: Name
properties.definition: Optional name for use by the participating software systems or users. For some subtypes of [[IfcRoot]] the insertion of the [[Name]] attribute may be required. This would be enforced by a where rule.

properties.name: Object Type
properties.definition: The type denotes a particular type that indicates the object further. The use has to be established at the level of instantiable subtypes. In particular it holds the user defined type, if the enumeration of the attribute PredefinedType is set to [[USERDEFINED]] or when the concrete entity instantiated does not have a PredefinedType attribute. The latter is the case in some exceptional leaf classes and when instantiating [[IfcBuiltElement]] directly.

properties.name: Tag
properties.definition: The tag (or label) identifier at the particular instance of a product, e.g. the serial number, or the position number. It is the identifier at the occurrence level.

properties.name: Assessment Condition
properties.definition: The overall condition of a product based on an assessment of the contributions to the overall condition made by the various criteria considered. The meanings given to the values of assessed condition should be agreed and documented by local agreements. For instance, is overall condition measured on a scale of 1 - 10 or by assigning names such as Good, OK, Poor.

properties.name: Assessment Date
properties.definition: Date on which the overall condition is assessed

properties.name: Assessment Description
properties.definition: Qualitative description of the condition.

properties.name: Assessment Frequency
properties.definition: Indicates how often the equipment should be assessed, to have a clear estimation on its working state, based on which the maintenance staff can decide whether it requires maintenance or requires to be updated or replaced.

properties.name: Assessment Method
properties.definition: External reference to assessment method or application used to perform the assessment.

properties.name: Assessment Type
properties.definition: [[Category]] of latest condition assessment report of the asset.

properties.name: Last Assessment Report
properties.definition: Reference to latest condition (state of health) report.

properties.name: Next Assessment Date
properties.definition: Date of next condition inspection

properties.name: Procurement Method
properties.definition: The method by which an IfcProductType/[[IfcProduct]] is acquired and installed.CFCI (meaning Contractor Furnished Contractor Installed), OFCI (meaning Owner Furnished Contractor Installed), or OFOI (meaning Owner Furnished Owner Installed).

properties.name: Specification Section Number
properties.definition: A reference number to an external contract technical specification section describing either (a) minimum performance requirements of a given IfcProductType/[[IfcProduct]] or (b) a preselection for a specific IfcProductType/[[IfcProduct]] made for this project.

properties.name: Submittal Identifer
properties.definition: The reference number to an external construction administration submittal used by the construction contractor and/or subcontractor to verify that the referenced IfcProductType/[[IfcProduct]] selection conforms with the requirements found in the referenced [[SpecificationSectionNumber]].

properties.name: Asset Identifier
properties.definition: A unique identification assigned to an asset that enables its differentiation from other assets.

properties.name: Installation Date
properties.definition: Date on which the element is installed.

properties.name: Model Number
properties.definition: The model number and/or unit designator assigned by the manufacturer of the manufactured item.

properties.name: Tag Number
properties.definition: Tag number.

properties.name: Conductor Function
properties.definition: Indicates function of the conductors to which the load is connected. Where L1, L2 and L3 represent the phase lines according to IEC 60446 notation (sometimes phase lines may be referenced by color Red, Blue, Yellow or by number 1, 2, 3 etc). Protective Earth is sometimes also known as CPC or common protective conductor. Note that for an electrical device, a set of line conductor functions may be applied.

properties.name: Earthing Style
properties.definition: Indicates the earthing style of the electric device.

properties.name: Has Protective Earth
properties.definition: Indicates whether the object has a protective earth connection (=TRUE) or not (= FALSE).

properties.name: Heat Dissipation
properties.definition: Indicates the heat dissipation of the electric device measured in power.

properties.name: Ik Code
properties.definition: IK Code according to IEC 62262 (2002) is a numeric classification for the degree of protection provided by enclosures for electrical equipment against external mechanical impacts.

properties.name: Insulation Standard Class
properties.definition: Insulation standard classes provides basic protection information against electric shock. Defines levels of insulation required in terms of constructional requirements (creepage and clearance distances) and electrical requirements (compliance with electric strength tests). Basic insulation is considered to be shorted under single fault conditions. The actual values required depend on the working voltage to which the insulation is subjected, as well as other factors. Also indicates whether the electrical device has a protective earth connection.

properties.name: IP Code
properties.definition: IP Code, the International Protection Marking, IEC 60529), classifies and rates the degree of protection provided against intrusion.

properties.name: Nominal Frequency Range
properties.definition: The upper and lower limits of frequency for which the operation of the device is certified.

properties.name: Nominal Power Consumption
properties.definition: Nominal total power consumption.

properties.name: Number of Poles
properties.definition: Number of poles that the object would affect.

properties.name: Number of Power Supply Ports
properties.definition: Indicates the number of power supply ports of the electric device.

properties.name: Power
properties.definition: The actual power and operable range.

properties.name: Power Factor
properties.definition: [[Power]] factor; usually as ratio.

properties.name: Rated Current
properties.definition: The current that a device is designed to handle.

properties.name: Rated Voltage
properties.definition: The range of allowed voltage that a device is certified to handle. The upper bound of this value is the maximum.

properties.name: Electro Magnetic Standards Compliance
properties.definition: Information about compliance with regard to electro magnetic related standards.

properties.name: Explosive Atmosphere Standards Compliance
properties.definition: Information about compliance with regard to explosive atmosphere related standards.

properties.name: Mitigated Risk Consequence
properties.definition: Identifies the consequence of the hazard given the planned mitigation.

properties.name: Mitigated Risk Likelihood
properties.definition: Identifies the likelihood of the hazard given the planned mitigation.

properties.name: Mitigated Risk Significance
properties.definition: Identifies the significance of the risk given the mitigation of likelihood and consequence.

properties.name: Mitigation Planned
properties.definition: The planned (agreed and irrevocable) mitigation of the likelhood and consequences of the hazard.

properties.name: Mitigation Proposed
properties.definition: Any proposed, but not yet agreed and irrevocable, mitigation of the likelhood and consequences of the hazard.

properties.name: Nature of Risk
properties.definition: A description of the generic nature of the context or hazard that might be encountered.

properties.name: Risk Assessment Methodology
properties.definition: An indication or link to the chosen risk assessment methodology, for example PAS1192-6 or a chosen ISO13100 annex.

properties.name: Risk Name

properties.name: Risk Type

properties.name: Unmitigated Risk Consequence

properties.name: Unmitigated Risk Likelihood

properties.name: Unmitigated Risk Significance

properties.name: Sound Curve

properties.name: Horizontal Flat Ness

properties.name: Horizontal Orthogonality

properties.name: Horizontal Straightness

properties.name: Horizontal Tolerance

properties.name: Orthogonal Orthogonality
properties.definition: Indicative (95%-100%) range orthogonality associated to the horizontal shape and orientation in Y, if different to the overall orthogonality.

properties.name: Orthogonal Straightness

properties.name: Orthogonal Tolerance
properties.definition: Indicative (95%-100%) range tolerance associated to the horizontal shape and position in Y, if different to the overall tolerance.

properties.definition: Indicative (95%-100%) range diameter associated to the vertical shape and position in X, if different to the linear uncertainty.

properties.name: Linear Uncertainty
properties.definition: Indicative (95%-100%) range diameter associated to the overall shape and position in XYZ.

properties.name: Orthogonal Uncertainty
properties.definition: Indicative (95%-100%) range diameter associated to the horizontal shape and position in Y, if different to the horizontal uncertainty.

properties.name: Uncertainty Basis
properties.definition: Indication of the basis of the uncertainty

properties.name: Uncertainty Description

properties.name: Vertical Uncertainty

properties.name: Exclusions
properties.definition: Items, conditions or actions that may be excluded from the warranty or that may cause the warranty to become void.

properties.name: Is Extended Warranty
properties.definition: Indication of whether this is an extended warranty whose duration is greater than that normally assigned to an artefact (=TRUE) or not (= FALSE).

properties.name: Point of Contact
properties.definition: The organization that should be contacted for action under the terms of the warranty. Note that the role of the organization (manufacturer, supplier, installer etc.) is determined by the IfcActorRole attribute of IfcOrganization.

properties.name: Warranty Content
properties.definition: The content of the warranty.

properties.name: Warranty Identifier
properties.definition: The identifier assigned to a warranty.

properties.name: Warranty Period
properties.definition: The time duration during which a manufacturer or supplier guarantees or warrants the performance of an artefact.

properties.name: Warranty Start Date
properties.definition: The date on which the warranty commences.

properties.name: Status
properties.definition: [[Status]] of the element, predominately used in renovation or retrofitting projects. The status can be assigned to as 'New' - element designed as new addition, 'Existing' - element exists and remains, 'Demolish' - element existed but is to be demolished, 'Temporary' - element will exists only temporary (like a temporary support structure).

allowedValues.description: 'Demolish' - element existed but is to be demolished
The status can be assigned to as 'New' - element designed as new addition
'Temporary' - element will exists only temporary (like a temporary support structure)

properties.name: Gross Surface Area
properties.definition: Total gross area of the object, normally generated as perimeter * length + 2 * cross section area. It is the sum of [[OuterSurfaceArea]] + (2 x [[CrossSectionArea]]) and shall only be given, if the [[OuterSurfaceArea]] and [[CrossSectionArea]] cannot be established separately.

properties.name: Gross Volume
properties.definition: Total gross volume of the object. Openings, recesses, enclosed objects and projections are not taken into account.

properties.name: Net Surface Area
properties.definition: Net surface area of the object, normally generated as perimeter * length + 2 * cross section area taking into account possible processing features (cut-out's, etc.) or openings and recesses.

properties.name: Net Volume
properties.definition: Total net volume of the object, taking into account possible processing features (cut-out's, etc.) or openings and recesses.

properties.name: Surface Genus After Features
properties.definition: The Surface Genus of the evaluated representation items after applying product-level geometric features such as openings and projections.Surface Genus is a topological measure that represents the number of 'holes' or 'handles' on a surface. For example, a sphere has genus 0, and a torus has genus 1.

properties.name: Surface Genus Before Features
properties.definition: The Surface Genus of the evaluated representation items before applying product-level geometric features such as openings and projections.Surface Genus is a topological measure that represents the number of 'holes' or 'handles' on a surface. For example, a sphere has genus 0, and a torus has genus 1.

properties.name: Gross Weight
properties.definition: Total Gross [[Weight]] of the object without any add-on parts and not taking into account possible processing features (cut-out's, etc.) or openings and recesses.

entities.name: Window
entities.definition: The window is a building element that is predominately used to provide natural light and fresh air. It includes vertical opening but also horizontal opening such as skylights or light domes. It includes constructions with swinging, pivoting, sliding, or revolving panels and fixed panels. A window consists of a lining and one or several panels.

predefinedTypes.name: Light Dome
predefinedTypes.definition: A special window that lies horizonally in a roof slab opening.

predefinedTypes.name: Sky Light
predefinedTypes.definition: A window within a sloped building element, usually a roof slab.

predefinedTypes.name: Window
predefinedTypes.definition: A standard window usually within a wall opening, as a window panel in a curtain wall, or as a 'free standing' window.

properties.name: Description
properties.definition: Optional description, provided for exchanging informative comments.

properties.name: Element Type
properties.definition: The type denotes a particular type that indicates the object further. The use has to be established at the level of instantiable subtypes. In particular it holds the user defined type, if the enumeration of the attribute 'PredefinedType' is set to [[USERDEFINED]].

properties.name: Global ID
properties.definition: Assignment of a globally unique identifier within the entire software world.

properties.name: Name
properties.definition: Optional name for use by the participating software systems or users. For some subtypes of [[IfcRoot]] the insertion of the [[Name]] attribute may be required. This would be enforced by a where rule.

properties.name: Object Type
properties.definition: The type denotes a particular type that indicates the object further. The use has to be established at the level of instantiable subtypes. In particular it holds the user defined type, if the enumeration of the attribute PredefinedType is set to [[USERDEFINED]] or when the concrete entity instantiated does not have a PredefinedType attribute. The latter is the case in some exceptional leaf classes and when instantiating [[IfcBuiltElement]] directly.

properties.name: Overall Height
properties.definition: Overall measure of the height, it reflects the Z Dimension of a bounding box, enclosing the body of the door opening. If omitted, the [[OverallHeight]] should be taken from the geometric representation of the [[IfcOpeningElement]] in which the door is inserted.

properties.name: Overall Width
properties.definition: Overall measure of the width, it reflects the X Dimension of a bounding box, enclosing the body of the door opening. If omitted, the [[OverallWidth]] should be taken from the geometric representation of the [[IfcOpeningElement]] in which the door is inserted.

properties.name: Para Meter Takes Precedence
properties.definition: The Boolean value reflects, whether the parameter given in the attached lining and panel properties exactly define the geometry (TRUE), or whether the attached style shape take precedence (FALSE). In the last case the parameter have only informative value. If not provided, no such information can be inferred.

properties.name: Partitioning Type
properties.definition: [[Type]] defining the general layout of the window type in terms of the partitioning of panels.

properties.name: Tag
properties.definition: The tag (or label) identifier at the particular instance of a product, e.g. the serial number, or the position number. It is the identifier at the occurrence level.

properties.name: User Defined Partitioning Type
properties.definition: Designator for the user defined partitioning type, shall only be provided, if the value of [[PartitioningType]] is set to [[USERDEFINED]].

properties.name: Assessment Condition
properties.definition: The overall condition of a product based on an assessment of the contributions to the overall condition made by the various criteria considered. The meanings given to the values of assessed condition should be agreed and documented by local agreements. For instance, is overall condition measured on a scale of 1 - 10 or by assigning names such as Good, OK, Poor.

properties.name: Assessment Date
properties.definition: Date on which the overall condition is assessed

properties.name: Assessment Description
properties.definition: Qualitative description of the condition.

properties.name: Assessment Frequency
properties.definition: Indicates how often the equipment should be assessed, to have a clear estimation on its working state, based on which the maintenance staff can decide whether it requires maintenance or requires to be updated or replaced.

properties.name: Assessment Method
properties.definition: External reference to assessment method or application used to perform the assessment.

properties.name: Assessment Type
properties.definition: [[Category]] of latest condition assessment report of the asset.

properties.name: Last Assessment Report
properties.definition: Reference to latest condition (state of health) report.

properties.name: Next Assessment Date
properties.definition: Date of next condition inspection

properties.name: Procurement Method
properties.definition: The method by which an IfcProductType/[[IfcProduct]] is acquired and installed.CFCI (meaning Contractor Furnished Contractor Installed), OFCI (meaning Owner Furnished Contractor Installed), or OFOI (meaning Owner Furnished Owner Installed).

properties.name: Specification Section Number
properties.definition: A reference number to an external contract technical specification section describing either (a) minimum performance requirements of a given IfcProductType/[[IfcProduct]] or (b) a preselection for a specific IfcProductType/[[IfcProduct]] made for this project.

properties.name: Submittal Identifer
properties.definition: The reference number to an external construction administration submittal used by the construction contractor and/or subcontractor to verify that the referenced IfcProductType/[[IfcProduct]] selection conforms with the requirements found in the referenced [[SpecificationSectionNumber]].

properties.name: Asset Identifier
properties.definition: A unique identification assigned to an asset that enables its differentiation from other assets.

properties.name: Installation Date
properties.definition: Date on which the element is installed.

properties.name: Model Number
properties.definition: The model number and/or unit designator assigned by the manufacturer of the manufactured item.

properties.name: Tag Number
properties.definition: Tag number.

properties.name: Fill Gas
properties.definition: [[Name]] of the gas by which the gap between two glass layers is filled. It is given for information purposes only.

properties.name: Glass Colour
properties.definition: [[Colour]] (tint) selection for this glazing. It is given for information purposes only.

properties.name: Glass Layer S
properties.definition: Number of glass layers within the frame. E.g. '2' for double glazing.

properties.name: Glass Thickness 1
properties.definition: [[Thickness]] of the first (inner) glass layer.

properties.name: Glass Thickness 2
properties.definition: [[Thickness]] of the second (intermediate or outer) glass layer.

properties.name: Glass Thickness 3
properties.definition: [[Thickness]] of the third (outer) glass layer.

properties.name: Is Coated
properties.definition: Indication whether the glass is coated with a material (TRUE) or not (FALSE).

properties.name: Is Laminated
properties.definition: Indication whether the glass is layered with other materials (TRUE) or not (FALSE).

properties.name: Is Tempered
properties.definition: Indication whether the glass is tempered (TRUE) or not (FALSE) .

properties.name: Is Wire D
properties.definition: Indication whether the glass includes a contained wire mesh to prevent break-in (TRUE) or not (FALSE)

properties.name: Shading Coefficient
properties.definition: The measure of the ability of a glazing to transmit solar heat, relative to that ability for 3 mm (1/8-inch) clear, double-strength, single glass. Shading coefficient is being phased out in favor of the solar heat gain coefficient (SHGC), and is approximately equal to the SHGC multiplied by 1.15. The shading coefficient is expressed as a number without units between 0 and 1.

properties.name: Solar Absorption
properties.definition: (Asol) The ratio of incident solar radiation that is absorbed by a glazing system. It is the sum of the absorption distributed to the exterior (a) and to the interior (qi). Note the following equation Asol + Rsol + Tsol = 1

properties.name: Solar Heat Gain Transmittance
properties.definition: The ratio of incident solar radiation that contributes to the heat gain of the interior, it is the solar radiation that directly passes (Tsol or τe) plus the part of the absorbed radiation that is distributed to the interior (qi). The SHGC is referred to also as g-value (g = τe + qi).

properties.name: Solar Reflectance
properties.definition: The ratio of incident solar radiation that is reflected by a glazing system (also named ρe). Note the following equation Asol + Rsol + Tsol = 1

properties.name: Solar Transmittance
properties.definition: The ratio of incident solar radiation that directly passes through a system (also named τe). Note the following equation Asol + Rsol + Tsol = 1

properties.name: Thermal Transmittance Summer
properties.definition: Thermal transmittance coefficient (U-[[Value]]) of a material.; Summer thermal transmittance coefficient of the glazing only, often referred to as (U-value).

properties.name: Thermal Transmittance Winter
properties.definition: Thermal transmittance coefficient (U-[[Value]]) of a material.; Winter thermal transmittance coefficient of the glazing only, often referred to as (U-value).

properties.name: Visible Light Reflectance
properties.definition: Fraction of the visible light that is reflected by the glazing at normal incidence. It is a value without unit.

properties.name: Visible Light Transmittance
properties.definition: Fraction of the visible light that passes the object at normal incidence. It is a value without unit.

properties.definition: Identifies the angular range of the kinematic behaviour

properties.name: Linear Path
properties.definition: distance table of the kinematic behaviour.

properties.definition: Identifies the linear range of the kinematic behaviour.

properties.name: Maximum Constant Speed

properties.name: Minimum Time

properties.name: Maximum Rain Intensity
properties.definition: Maximum level of rain intensity that the equipment can operate effectively in. It is usually measured in millimeter per hour (mm/h).

properties.name: Maximum Solar Radiation
properties.definition: Maximum level of solar irradiance that the equipment can operate effectively in. This is usually tested and measured by a national or international standard. The value indicates power density measured in watt per square meter (w/m2).

properties.name: Maximum Wind Speed
properties.definition: Maximum resistance to wind load exposure.

properties.name: Reference Air Relative Humidity

properties.name: Reference Environment Temperature

properties.name: Salt Mist Level
properties.definition: Maximum level of salt mist that the equipment can operate effectively in. It is provided according to an international or national standard.

properties.name: Seismic Resistance
properties.definition: Maximum magnitude of earthquake that the equipment complies with. The value indicates earthquake intensity measured in Richter scale.

properties.name: Smoke Level
properties.definition: Maximum level of smoke that the equipment complies with. It is provided according to an international or national standard.

properties.name: Storage Temperature Range
properties.definition: Allowed storage temperature range that the element complies with.

properties.definition: Rating of the asset's criticality to the operation of the facility

properties.name: Asset F Rail TY

properties.definition: Combined criticality and frailty rating indicating the operational and maintenance priority of the asset

properties.name: Condition Re Placement Level

properties.definition: [[Performance]] level at which replacement takes place

properties.name: Target Performance
properties.definition: Target capacity or performance of the asset. Units of the performance value are specified through the propertyValue units attribute.

properties.name: Acquisition Date
properties.definition: The date that the manufactured item was purchased.

properties.name: Assembly Place
properties.definition: Enumeration defining where the assembly is intended to take place, either in a factory, other offsite location or on the building site.

properties.name: Bar Code
properties.definition: The identity of the bar code given to an occurrence of the product.

properties.name: Batch Reference
properties.definition: The identity of the batch reference from which an occurrence of a product is taken.

properties.name: Manufacturing Date
properties.definition: Date on which the element was manufactured.

properties.name: Serial Number
properties.definition: The manufacturer's serial number assigned to an occurrence of a product.

properties.name: Article Number
properties.definition: Article number or reference that is be applied to a configured product according to a standard scheme for article number definition as defined by the manufacturer. It is often used as the purchasing number.
